The Digital Solutions team within the Mott MacDonald Digital, Technology \& Services portfolio develops and supports a diverse range of bespoke and product\-based software systems for clients across the UK, internationally and within the Mott MacDonald group. These systems are developed by our in\-house software engineering team, utilising a wide range of programming technologies, deployed into varying technology stacks. We provide a dynamic, project\-orientated development environment, with teams involved in the full lifecycle of system delivery from requirements definition through to design, development, platform configuration, and ultimately live system support.


Our primary domain is in the Transport sector, solving real\-world problems for clients that manage transport networks and own all forms of transport assets – digital, data, and infrastructure. We also provide technical input across multiple domains for projects across Mott MacDonald meaning we play our part in maintaining Mott MacDonald’s carbon neutral certification.

  

**Candidate Specification**

  

At Mott MacDonald, we’re looking for curious, motivated graduates who want to make a real difference. Join our purpose\-driven teams where your ideas matter, your growth is supported, and your work enhances the world we live in.


To be eligible for this opportunity, you will have less than 12 months’ relevant experience (excluding placements) and have a minimum of a bachelor’s degree (obtained no earlier than 2025\) or expected to achieve one in one of the following degree disciplines (that have a significant Java, C\#, and/or Python content):


* Computer science
* Software engineering
* Other software related disciplines
Some of these opportunities will require you to be eligible to achieve security clearance. Security clearance is dictated by the types of projects we work on and normally requires you to be a UK British national or lived in the UK for five years or more.

  

In your application, you should aim to demonstrate your genuine interest in both the opportunity and in joining Mott MacDonald. You can do this by highlighting any relevant experience or interests \- such as modules you've studied, previous work experience, or any research you've undertaken about our company, values, and projects.


We personally review every completed application form we receive as this part of our selection process is entirely human led – we do not use AI tools at this stage and kindly ask you not to either. We want you to answer each application question with authenticity so we can get to know the real you. Joining us as a graduate is your opportunity to shape your own story.

  

We are looking for graduates with the following strengths:


* Proactively takes initiative to complete tasks efficiently and independently.
* Communicates effectively and clearly with clients and colleagues.
* Delivers high quality written work with strong attention to detail and clarity.
* Demonstrates a structured and analytical approach to problem solving.
  

**UK Immigration**


Mott MacDonald Ltd. are not currently offering sponsorship to candidates under the Skilled Worker visa route in the UK. This decision is as a consequence of the changes made to the Skilled Worker route by the UK Government in April 2024\.


Our ethos is to develop, train and retain our graduates and therefore we are looking for a long\-term relationship with our graduates. For this reason, we cannot accept applications from candidates who would be working under the Graduate visa route or other time\-limited visas, (irrespective of visa duration), due to their temporary nature and the requirement for sponsorship under the Skilled Worker route in future.


We continue to welcome applications from candidates who are eligible for alternative immigration routes in the UK, that do not require sponsorship as a Skilled Worker now or in future.

  

**AI Usage**


At Mott MacDonald, we see the value AI can bring, but we take a people\-first approach to hiring. While AI tools can help candidates prepare and build confidence, every application and hiring decision is reviewed by our recruitment and hiring teams. We encourage the responsible use of AI while ensuring we get to know the real person behind the application.

  

**Accessibility**

We want you to feel supported and able to perform at your best throughout our recruitment process. If there is anything we can do to make applying or interviewing with us more accessible, please contact us at **reasonable.adjustments@mottmac.com** and we'll be happy to discuss how we can help.

  

**About your development**


A graduate position should be more than just a job. We know this and so do you. That’s why with our graduate roles we aim to give you the experience and technical knowledge you need to progress your career. From the moment you join us, you’ll receive the training you need. You will be assigned a mentor, who will guide you to meet the objectives of your professional training needs. You will join our three\-year early careers soft skills development programme – Accelerating your Future, which is designed to give you the skills and tools necessary for a long\-lasting successful career here at Mott MacDonald.

  

**Our social side**

  

  

Being part of Mott MacDonald means more than just work; there’s a huge range of fun and exciting things that you can get involved in.


From the moment you join us, you’ll have the opportunity to expand your social and professional network, whether it’s meeting other graduates or joining forces with other members of staff from around the company at our annual sports day. Each of our offices have a sports and social committee which will give you the chance to be part of a variety of sports, social and charity events. We’re committed to promoting a strong culture of social responsibility and encourage our staff to play active roles in the local community.


It's worth noting that sports and social committees tend to vary from office to office, so as well as getting involved in what’s already on offer, don’t be afraid to suggest new events or initiatives that you think could be a great addition. It doesn’t stop there. From your first day, you’ll have access to Perks at Work, giving you discounts on cinema tickets, travel, utilities and much more, helping you make the most of our employee benefits.

  

**Agile working**

At Mott MacDonald, we believe it makes business sense for you and your manager to choose how you can work most effectively to meet your client, team, and personal commitments. We offer a hybrid working policy that embraces your well\-being, flexibility, and trust.

  

**Equality, diversity, and inclusion**


We put equality, diversity, and inclusion at the heart of our business, seeking to promote fair employment procedures and practices to ensure equal opportunities for all. We encourage individual expression in our workplace and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where **everyone** feels they can contribute.

  

**We offer some fantastic benefits including:**

  

**Financial wellbeing**


* **Biannual salary reviews:** We believe hard work should be recognised and rewarded. To support your development and progression, you'll be eligible for salary reviews twice a year during your first three years with us, subject to successfully completing your probation period.
* We match employee pension contributions between 4\.5% and 7%.
* Life assurance equal up to 4 x your basic salary, with an option to increase the level of cover to 6 x your salary.
* Our income protection scheme provides a financial benefit, as well as absence and return to work support due to long\-term illness or injury.
* Flexible benefits, including increased life assurance cover, critical illness insurance, payroll saving and will writing.
* As an independently owned business we share the financial success of the business with all our colleagues in various ways including annual bonus schemes.
  

**Employee Ownership**


* Our employee ownership model means no external investors, just us, creating a culture of shared success.
* Our employees have a stake and a voice in our business, giving them a direct connection to our success through our personal and group performance bonuses.
* As your career grows, so does your stake, recognising your long\-term impact and contribution.
* Your voice matters, with the opportunity to connect directly with senior leadership through formal channels to help shape our future.
* For our senior roles you will have a direct pathway towards ownership from day one.
  

**Health and wellbeing**


* Private medical insurance for all UK colleagues.
* Health cash plan to support you with every day health costs and treatments.
* Access to Peppy, providing free support from menopause experts for all UK colleagues.
* A variety of wellbeing support is available through our comprehensive wellbeing program, including access for you and your family.
* Ability to flex your salary to opt into a wide range of health benefits, many of which can be extended to your family too.
  

**Lifestyle**

* 33 days holiday each year, inclusive of public holidays and dependent on level, with the ability to buy or sell leave through our flexible benefits programme.
* 10 days additional paid leave for Armed Forces Reservists and Cadet Force Adult Volunteers.
* Holiday entitlement increased to a minimum of 35 days after 5 years’ service.
* Variety of employee saving schemes and discounts from high\-street retailers.
  

**Enhanced family and carers leave**


* Enhanced family leave policies, including 26 weeks paid maternity and adoption leave, and two weeks paid paternity/partner leave.
* Our shared parental leave matches maternity leave meaning we pay up to 24 weeks at full pay.
* Up to five additional days leave are provided for those with significant caring responsibilities, two of which are paid.
* We offer policies and dedicated support to help military families balance service life with career and wellbeing.
  

**Learning and development**


* Primary annual professional institution subscription.
* A broad range of opportunities to enhance both technical and soft skills through mentoring, formal training, and self\-development options.
  

**Networks, communities, and social outcomes**


* Join a wide range of groups including our Advanced Employee Networks which support our LGBTQ\+, gender, race and ethnicity, disability, and parents/carers communities.
* We are proud signatories of the Armed Forces Covenant and Gold Award holders in the MOD Employer Recognition Scheme, supported by our dedicated internal Armed Forces Network.
* Make a difference within our communities through our social outcomes.

jobs.title: Principal Authorising Engineer
jobs.description:
### **About The Role**



**Why choose us?**

  


**BRUSH Group** **provides the energy solutions that help power our built world****.** From power transformers to switchgear and engineering solutions, for generations, the **BRUSH** brand has stood for engineering excellence.



We are committed to supporting the global effort for industrial decarbonisation and sustainable development and have set ambitious objectives to achieve our target of net zero greenhouse gas emissions by 2050\.

  




**What's** **the role?**

  




Eta Projects Ltd. provide Authorising Services to a range of clients across the United Kingdom and Ireland. Founded in 1995 primarily as a M\&E Design Consultancy, Eta Projects Ltd has developed its Authorising Services ergonomically as the Company has grown and now offers M\&E Authorising Engineering services to a wide range of clients within the NHS and other industry sectors.  

  

The role purpose is to monitor and audit SSoW predominately within and Healthcare environment, reporting on compliance with Statutory and Company procedures. The role will be remote based from home but will require travel to client sites. The role involves;  

  

* Providing timely and accurate input to incident investigations and resolving technical operational issues.
* Audit, process and findings of the Technical Compliance Audits – assist with the closure of the non\-conformances.
* Managing and offering guidance of Electrical Equipment Safety Alerts.
* Issuing audit findings via a technical audit report to Designated Person/Principal Engineer agreeing a suitable site AP Action Plan.
* Maintaining a register of all Authorised Persons including their training records and areas of responsibility.
* To act as Technical Lead offering advice and guidance on a range of complex electrical projects and systems.
  


**Key Responsibilities:**



* Undertaking technical compliance audits, reporting on areas of non\-compliance.
* Identify, develop, assess and recommend for appointment suitable candidates for Appointment as Authorised Person.
* Assessing the experience, training and competence of Authorised Persons; providing recommendations of appointment.
* Providing technical and engineering support to ensure all Authorised Persons are competent to carry out their function to ensure compliance and succession planning.
* Implementation, Administration, Auditing and Monitoring of Safe systems of Work associated with Statutory Electrical Regulations.
* Responsible for ensuring compliance with the Health and Safety at Work etc. Act (1974\) , the Electricity at Work Regulations (1989\) and HTM 06\-02 and HTM 06\-03\.
* Undertake investigations with respect near misses and accidents, consulting with enforcing authorities where required in the role of an Authorising Engineer.
* Function as the focal point to the Senior Management internally within the business and externally within Client Teams in all matters relating to the Safe System of Work.
* Provide the necessary assurances that the relevant SSoW is being appropriately implemented at site level through the AE Audits undertaken and the Assessment of Competence of the Authorised Persons.
  


**What** **we’re** **looking** **for:**



* Detailed knowledge and Understanding of HTM 06/02 and HTM 06/03 and or JSP 375 Vol 3\.
* Degree, HND or HNC in a technical or engineering field or similar qualification.
* Full UK driving license.
* Must be able to demonstrate a good understanding of UK Health and Safety Legislation and an ability to carry out risk assessments and propose actions for risk control/management.
* Excellent communication skills both written and verbal, with ability to communicate at the highest level.
* Knowledge of Healthcare support systems.
* Computer literete in Microsoft Office suite.
* Detailed knowledge and understanding of HTM 06/02 and HTM 06/03 and/or JSP 375 Vol 3\.
* Chartered or an Incorporated engineer with practical and relevant technical engineering experience of working within NHS and/or MOD systems is essential
* Recent experience working as an Authorised Engineer or extensive experience working as a Senior Authorised Person.
* Technical background with respect to relevant disciplines for appointment as an Authorising Engineer to include High Voltage and Low Voltage systems.
* Experience in working within a structured safe system at work.


**Preferable (not essential):**

* Completed an approved Authorised Person training course in the last three years.
* Completed an approved Authorising Engineer training course in the last three years or within six months of a first\-time nomination
  


**What'****s** **in** **it for you?**


* Competitive salary
* Holiday allowance starting at 26 days per annum plus bank holidays (pro rata for part time roles)
* Flexible and Hybrid working options (role dependant)
* Life insurance – 4 x annual salary
* Enhanced Company Pension scheme
* 24/7 free and confidential Employee Assistance Programme
* GP24 Service – Access to remote, private GP services 24/7, 365 days a year plus Second Medical Opinions.
* BRUSHRewards – Discover plenty of ways to get more active and make great savings on everyday essentials as well as gifts for loved ones, holidays and special treats for yourself.
* Family friendly policies including Enhanced Maternity/Paternity
* Bike2work scheme
* Long Service Awards
* Developing our people is important to us \- we support and encourage development by offering ongoing professional development and training.
### **About The Company**


**Eta Projects Ltd**, part of the BRUSH Group, is a multi\-disciplined engineering consultancy practice that specialise in mechanical, electrical and public health (MEP) infrastructure projects. Accredited and active members of many professional institutes, ETA Projects Ltd are a Lloyds registered designer for network substations up to and including 33kV and ensure business continuity for mission critical infrastructures.


Providing a wide range of specialist infrastructure design and operational support services, ETA Projects Ltd specialises in critical power systems, especially the integration of new systems into existing complex environments, including acute healthcare, environment, secure IT and education.

jobs.title: Project Engineer
jobs.description:
**Project Engineer (Delivery)**  

**From £45,400 up to £56,750 per year (DOE) – plus a competitive benefits package and excellent career progression opportunities**

  

**Location: Llandudno, Wales**  

**Permanent / Full Time**

**Hybrid/Flexible**

  

**Closing Date: 05/10/26**

  

At SP Energy Networks our focus is on harnessing technology and innovation to create the networks of the future. Our team is building a dynamic network to meet the changing demands for electricity and increasingly, renewable electricity – safely, securely, and sustainably in the communities we serve.

  

  

At SP Energy Networks, we know people are central to building a better future, quicker and we are seeking new talent to join our team.

  

***Help us create a better future, quicker***  



***Role***

  

Join us in delivering a safe, reliable, and sustainable electricity network. In this role, you will lead the delivery of Operations \& Maintenance, Investment Projects, or Customer Projects, ensuring work is completed safely, efficiently, and in full compliance with regulatory and licence requirements, while providing excellent service to our customers and stakeholders.

  

***What you’ll be doing***

  

Deliver district business plan outputs in line with financial, regulatory, licence and customer service objectives, maximising value through performance and incentive mechanisms.

  

  

Build and maintain effective relationships with customers, communities, contractors and stakeholders to support successful project delivery and positive customer outcomes.

  

  

Develop and deliver robust project plans that support district and licence objectives while minimising customer interruptions and disruption to the network.

  

  

Ensure efficient and effective delivery of performance targets as appropriate, such as:

  

  

* Customer Minutes Lost, Customer Interruptions
* Broad Measure of Customer Satisfaction
* Guaranteed Standards
* Other Incentive mechanisms
  

  

Manage project risks, issues and dependencies, ensuring appropriate mitigation actions are implemented to support successful delivery.

  

  

Undertake project and contract management activities to ensure works are delivered safely, on time, within budget, and to the required quality standards.

  

  

To drive continual performance improvement through analysis of outputs and feedback from internal and external sources.

  

  

Integrate asset stewardship and ownership values through sound engineering principles and coordinated planning and delivery activities to improve integrity, safety and longevity of the electrical network.

  

  

Promote an exemplary safety culture and ensure that all safety legislation, policies, and procedures are implemented and adhered to across all activities.

  

***Depending on business requirements, you may support the delivery of:***

  

* Maintenance and reliability programmes
* Customer connections activities
* Capital investment projects
* Network security and system performance initiatives
  

  

Ensure the accurate and timely recording of operational, project, asset and customer information within corporate systems to support business, regulatory and customer service requirements.

  

***What you’ll bring***

  

Project/programme management experience, with a strong performance ethos and a track record of driving and delivering projects and initiatives.

  

  

Knowledge of the regulatory environment including relevant output and incentive mechanisms.

  

  

General contract, commercial and regulatory awareness with the ability to balance effective and efficient customer service and project delivery, ensuring maximum return on investment.

  

  

Effective stakeholder and customer service engagement and management.

  

  

Ability to communicate and present information effectively at all levels.

  

  

Ability to manage competing priorities using sound engineering and financial judgement to determine optimal solutions.

  

  

Awareness and understanding of key business drivers and the external commercial context in which SPEN is operating.

  

  

Ability to devise solutions to complex problems/challenges.

  

  

Where required, expert knowledge of:

  

  

* + Construction and maintenance standards
	+ Engineering standards and specifications up to 33kV

***Minimum Criteria***

  

* Engineering/Professional qualification or equivalent experience
* Experience in a project delivery role
* Relevant network construction and operational experience
* Computer literacy
  

***What’s in it for you***

  

As well as a competitive salary which is reviewed annually, you can also enjoy a number of other benefits. With our pension scheme, we’ll double match your contribution up to a company contribution of 10%.

  

  

At ScottishPower, we believe it’s the little things we do in life that make a big difference. From helping you look after your family’s wellbeing, save for your future and take personal steps for climate action – our benefits are designed to help you do just that \- so that you have everything you need to take care of your world – today and tomorrow.

  

  

That’s why our benefits include:

  

  

* 36 days annual leave
* Holiday Purchase – perfect your work/life balance with extra annual leave
* Share Schemes
* Payroll Giving and Charity Matched Funding
* Technology Vouchers – save more and spread the cost of your technology purchases
* Electric Vehicle Schemes – to help you transition to green/clean driving
* Cycle to Work scheme and Public Transport Season Ticket Loans
* Healthcare benefit options including: Dental Insurance, Private Medical Insurance, Health Cash Plan and annual Health Assessments
* Life Assurance (4x salary)
* Access to Savesmart financial wellbeing support
* Plus shopping, leisure, restaurant and gym discounts, and unique employee deals on travel insurance and more
  

***Why SP Energy Networks***

  

SP Energy Networks is part of the Iberdrola Group, one of the world’s largest integrated utility companies and a world leader in wind energy. We keep electricity flowing to homes and businesses through Central and Southern Scotland, North Wales and in the North West of England. We operate over 4000km of cables and lines that make\-up the transmission network – connecting infrastructure like wind farms into the electricity system. It’s a role that puts us right at the heart of Scotland’s ambition to be Net Zero by 2044\. And we’re taking it very seriously.

  

  

We’re investing £10 billion into our transmission network, directly supporting the rapid growth needed in renewable energy.

  

  

With diverse opportunities across our businesses and a commitment to invest in our own internal talent, ScottishPower can offer people real career opportunities that meet personal and professional goals, in a global organisation.

  

  

Inclusion, diversity, and a social purpose are at the heart of everything we do. Together with our values, they bring us together into a stronger, more sustainable business with direct links to the communities we serve. It takes all kinds of people to build a large\-scale business like ours, so whatever your background, you’ll fit right in.

  

  

We are committed to providing reasonable support or adjustments in our recruiting processes for candidates with disabilities, long term conditions, mental health conditions, or who are neurodivergent or require pregnancy\-related support. If you need support, please reach out to careers@scottishpower.com .


**Mobility**

Please note that any applicant who is not a citizen of the country of the vacancy will be subject to compliance with the applicable immigration requirements to legally work in that country. If/when required, the Company will support the employee with the necessary Immigration requirements.

jobs.title: Software Tester (Unit Test/AtlassianToolchain) - Contractor
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced Software Tester to join a multi\-disciplinary engineering team delivering safety\- and mission\-critical software for the maritime defence sector. You will be embedded with the various development teams, working at the code level as well as the system level, and taking ownership of the unit and integration test estate across both Windows and Linux targets.



This is a first hand role for a tester who is comfortable in the codebase. As well as designing and executing tests, you will strengthen the test tooling, keep automated test execution running reliably in the CI pipeline, and ensure that test evidence is traceable from requirement through to result within the Atlassian toolchain.



The successful candidate will work on site at our Rugeley, Staffordshire facility, alongside software engineers, systems engineers, and quality assurance colleagues.

  


**Key Responsibilities:**


* Design, write, review, and maintain unit tests for new and legacy code, working to agreed coverage and quality targets.
* Develop and maintain integration and regression test suites that execute automatically on both Windows and Linux build agents.
* Analyse requirements and design documentation to derive test cases and maintain bidirectional traceability from requirement to test case to result.
* Own the test management workflow in Jira — including test issue types, workflows, boards, and reporting — and keep test artefacts current in Confluence.
* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (Bitbucket Pipelines, Bamboo or Jenkins), diagnose pipeline failures, and keep the build green.
* Investigate, reproduce, and clearly document defects; triage them with developers and track them to closure.
* Produce test plans, test specifications, test reports, and evidence packs suitable for internal review and customer acceptance.
* Measure and report on code coverage, test pass rates, and defect trends, and recommend improvements where quality risk is emerging.
* Support code reviews with a testability and quality perspective and coach developers on effective unit testing practice.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of test strategy, tooling, and process across the programme.
* Work within the organisation’s configuration management, information security, and quality management procedures always.

  


**Essential Skills and Experience:**


**Testing**


* Demonstrable commercial experience as a software tester, test engineer, or SDET on a software development team.
* Strong practical experience of unit testing and test\-driven development, using frameworks such as Google Test, Catch2, CppUnit, NUnit, xUnit, MSTest, JUnit or pytest.
* Ability to read, write and debug code in at least one of C\+\+, C\#, Java, or Python to write meaningful tests and reproduce defects.
* Experience with mocking and test\-double frameworks (for example Google Mock, Moq, Mockito, unittest.mock).
* Working knowledge of code coverage and static analysis tooling (for example gcov/lcov, OpenCover, SonarQube, Coverity, Polyspace).
* Experience designing test cases from written requirements and maintaining requirements\-to\-test traceability.
* Sound defect management practice — clear reproduction steps, severity assessment, evidence capture and closure verification.


**Atlassian suite**


* Firsthand experience with Jira, including creating and configuring boards, workflows, issue types, filters, and dashboards.
* Experience with a Jira test management application such as Xray, Zephyr Scale or TestRail integration.
* Confluence authoring — test plans, test specifications, procedures, and structured technical documentation.
* Bitbucket for source control, branching strategy, pull requests and code review.
* Experience configuring and troubleshooting automated builds and test stages in Bamboo, Bitbucket Pipelines.


**Platforms and tooling**


* Confident working across both Windows and Linux — command line, scripting, filesystem, permissions, and services on each.
* Scripting for test automation and environment setup (PowerShell, Bash, and/or Python).
* Familiarity with cross\-platform build systems and toolchains (CMake, MSBuild, make, GCC/Clang, MSVC).
* Comfortable setting up and maintaining test environments, including virtual machines and containers.
* Git fluency — branching, merging, rebasing, and resolving conflicts.


**Desirable Skills:**


* Prior experience in defence, maritime, aerospace, nuclear, rail or another safety\- or security\-critical regulated domain.
* Awareness of relevant standards and practice such as DO\-178C, IEC 61508, MISRA C/C\+\+, or Def Stan 00\-055/00\-056\.
* ISTQB Foundation (or higher) certification, or equivalent formal test qualification.
* Experience testing embedded, real\-time, sensor or signal\-processing software.
* Experience of hardware\-in\-the\-loop or rig\-based testing, and of testing against simulated data sets.
* Exposure to test automation at system level (for example Robot Framework, Squish, Selenium, or bespoke harnesses).
* Experience of formal verification and validation activities and customer witness testing.
* Familiarity with Atlassian administration, including permission schemes and app configuration.

  


**Note: All candidates must meet the security vetting requirements relevant to the role. For reasons of national security, applicants must be British nationals. Dual nationals may be permitted in exceptional circumstances.**

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Quality & Process
jobs.description:
**ABOUT ORGANOX:**

OrganOx is a commercial stage organ technology company dedicated to developing technologies to improve outcomes for patients with acute or chronic organ failure. The company was established as a spin out of the University of Oxford in 2008 and is now part of the Terumo Group. OrganOx is a pioneer in normothermic machine perfusion (NMP). It's flagship platform, the metra®, is available for use in the U.S., Europe, Canada, and Australia. It has been utilized in over 7,000 liver transplants to date to keep donor livers in a metabolically active state outside the body enabling longer preservation times and functional assessment of the organ prior to transplant, leading to an increased number of organs available for transplant. Founded in 1921, Terumo Corporation (TSE:4543\) strives to fulfil its mission of “Contributing to Society through Healthcare” by providing a comprehensive range of solutions in the fields of therapeutic procedures, hospital operations, and life sciences in more than 160 countries and regions.

 **Position Summary**

The Software Engineer, Quality \& Process will utilise their extensive experience in Software Quality Assurance, particularly in cloud solutions used in medical applications and embedded medical device development. This role will play a critical role in ensuring our cloud platform and medical devices meet the stringent quality and regulatory standards required for medical devices.


This is a fantastic opportunity to join a fast\-growing organisation in a strategic role that will have significant impact on the company’s digital offering and contribute to how organ transplants are delivered. While this position is in the Software Development team, the role works in partnership with the quality function.


This is an on\-site position in Oxford with flexibility.


Listed below are the major responsibilities of the role and a brief description of some of the key tasks to be performed. This list is not totally exhaustive.


**Major Responsibilities**


Under direction from the Director, Embedded Software Development, the Software Engineer, Quality \& Process will be responsible for:


**Quality Assurance \& Testing:**

* Development, implementation and maintenance of the Software Technical File for the products, defining the documental strategy and facilitating submissions.
* Act as primary interface between Software and Quality and Regulatory teams.
* Participate in the development and maintenance of software processes that meets all relevant Regulatory requirements, including but not limited to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and Working Instructions (WI).
* Define and execute improvements activities, including but not limited to Corrective Actions Preventive Actions (CAPAs).
* Oversee the SOUP (Software of Unknown Provenance) and Tools validations securing compliance with internal QMS (Quality Management System).

**Compliance \& Documentation:**

* Create all the software related documentation, including requirements, design, test reports and traceability, ensuring compliance and excellence in the rigour applied including derived outcome.
* Develop templates for software documentation and facilitate their integration with the software development toolchain, including the Continuous Integration/ Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) artifacts.
* Proactively manage partnerships, preparing and maintaining detailed documentation, including test plans, test cases, test scripts and test reports.

**Risk and Cybersecurity Risk Management:**

* Drive the software risk analysis activities, including the development and maintenance of the Failure Mode Effect Analysis (FMEA), identification of mitigations and their inclusion in the design input documentation.
* Drive the cybersecurity activities including threat modelling, penetration tests, identification, assessment and mitigation of software\-related and cybersecurity risks, including those associated with the outsourced development and testing processes.
* Drive a key focus to develop and maintain a risk management plan in accordance with relevant standards and frameworks, ensuring all identified risks are documented and mitigated effectively.
* Take the lead to ensure regular and comprehensive review and update of software related risk through the software FMEA, to address any emerging risks during the software development lifecycle.

**Collaboration \& Communication:**

* Role models effective stakeholder collaboration, working closely with software developers, product managers and other partners to understand requirements and design effective testing strategies.
* Ensures timely communication of findings, risks and recommendations, which are effective and clear to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
Adhere to and role model the spirit of OrganOx’s Code of Conduct and all other company policies  
* 

  

  

**Requirements** **Skills \& Experience**

* Demonstrated experience in a similar role, preferably within the medical device industry.
* Proven experience in software quality assurance, with a focus on cloud solutions and software for Medical Devices (essential)
* Strong understanding of software development, testing methodologies, tools and processes (essential)
* Proven experience applying regulatory standards for Medical Devices (e.g., ISO 13485, FDA regulations, EN 62304, IEC 62366\) (essential)
* Engineering experience in software risk management (ISO 14971\), including cybersecurity risk management (essential)
* Excellent problem\-solving skills and attention to detail (essential)
* Strong communication and collaboration skills (essential)
* Proven experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud and IoMT solutions (desirable)
* Knowledge of medical device software lifecycle processes (essential)
* Familiarity in programming languages such as Python, Java, C\# or C/C\+\+ (desirable)
* Proven experience with continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines (desirable)
* Familiarity with relevant cybersecurity standards and frameworks (e.g., IEC 62443, NIST Cybersecurity Framework (essential)

  



**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field.
Relevant certifications in software quality assurance or testing (e.g., ISTQB).  
* 

  

  

**Benefits**  

At OrganOx, we value innovation, evidence, integrity, teamwork, respect, and passion. We offer competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, including healthcare and retirement plans. We support work\-life balance and provide opportunities for ongoing professional development.


*We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation race, or any other characteristics protected by law.*

jobs.title: Software Engineering Internship
jobs.description:
We tackle the most complex problems in quantitative finance, by bringing scientific clarity to financial complexity.

  

From our London HQ, we unite world\-class researchers and engineers in an environment that values deep exploration and methodical execution \- because the best ideas take time to evolve. Together we’re building a world\-class platform to amplify our teams’ most powerful ideas.

  

As part of our engineering team, you’ll shape the platforms and tools that drive high\-impact research \- designing systems that scale, accelerate discovery and support innovation across the firm.

  

Take the next step in your career.

**We are part of Allegro and we are specialists in providing advanced IT systems for logistics management.**

* **Modern Tech Stack**: Work with a world\-class environment using C\#, .NET Core, ASP.NET, REST, PostgreSQL, Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, EntityFramework, and Redis.

Join the team building the technological foundation of Allegro One logistics! Our systems support the end\-to\-end parcel flow \- from pickup through sorting, depots, and last\-mile delivery. Processing millions of logistics events daily, our backend services directly impact stability and efficiency for thousands of couriers, warehouse workers, and drivers.


You will have a chance to build and refine the high\-performance infrastructure powering our logistics network. We prioritize high reliability, modern engineering practices, and a supportive team culture. This role offers an excellent opportunity to actively shape our backend architecture while solving high\-scale challenges.

===================================================================

  

Join either **Data Discovery \& Experience** or **API Platform** , two teams within API \& Data Products Solutions.


Our mission is to make APIs, MCPs and Data easy to discover, understand, and use. To support that journey, we are looking for an AI Developer who is excited about building the next generation of AI\-powered experiences.

  

  

**About the role**
------------------


You will help shape AI\-powered experiences by enabling AI agents, APIs, MCPs, and Data Products to create value for developers, employees, partners, and customers.

  

  

Working hands\-on with modern AI technologies, agent frameworks, APIs, and platform capabilities, you will build scalable solutions that enable teams across If to discover, access, and use digital capabilities more effectively.

  

  

As part of a cross\-functional team of Product Managers, Architects, Engineers, and business stakeholders, you will turn emerging AI opportunities into practical solutions with measurable business impact.

  

  

* Help evolve our Data Discovery \& Experience or API Platform capabilities.
* Design and develop AI\-powered platform capabilities using AI agents, APIs, MCPs, and Data Products.
* Improve how APIs, MCPs, and Data Products are discovered, understood, and used across If.
* Help ensure secure access using open standards.
* Apply platform engineering and product thinking to solve real business problems.
* Contribute to AI literacy and AI\-enabled ways of working.

**We offer**
------------


In the same way that we place high demands on you as an employee, we also expect you to place high demands on us as an employer. Here are some of the benefits of working at If:

  

  

* An including work environment where everyone is welcome
* Career and development opportunities in the biggest insurance company in the Nordics
* Social activities, as well as highly skilled professional environment
* Possibility of hybrid workplace
* Health promoting workplace with e.g., wellness allowance and various sports activities
* Great insurance benefits
* Lunch benefit
  

  

**About the team**
------------------


Depending on your background, interests, and experience, you may join either the **Data Discovery \& Experience** team or the **API Platform** team.


The **Data Discovery \& Experience** team works closely with business and technical stakeholders to improve how APIs and Data are discovered, understood, and used as Products across If.

  

  

The **API Platform** team focuses on building and evolving common platform capabilities that enable secure, scalable, and efficient API consumption and integration across If and with external partners.


Both teams use agile ways of working and collaborate closely with stakeholders across business and technology domains.

  

  

This position is also a part of a larger agile Tribe responsible for providing common API and IAM capabilities that enable If's business to grow in a secure, scalable, and compliant manner. We support both internal teams and external partners through technology, products, processes, training, and governance.

  

  

**Who are you?**
----------------


You are curious, innovative, and motivated by making hard things look easy.

  

  

You enjoy experimenting with new technologies and turning ideas into working solutions. You combine strong technical skills with a product mindset and are excited about creating experiences that are useful, intuitive, and valuable to users.

  

  

You are comfortable navigating uncertainty, learning quickly, and working in a field that is evolving.

  

  

You see AI not as a standalone technology, but as a capability that becomes powerful when combined with data, business processes, and great user experiences.

  

  

You are passionate about agile ways of working, continuous improvement, and exploring new technologies.

  

  

You have the ability to make complex technical concepts understandable and actionable for both technical and business stakeholders.  

  



You also have:


* Relevant university degree, preferably within Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Data \& Analytics, or a related technical field. Equivalent practical experience is also valued.
* Experience in the insurance industry or another regulated industry, such as banking, finance, healthcare, telecommunications, or the public sector.
* At least 3 years of experience in software engineering and modern application development.
* At least 1\-2 years of practical, hands\-on experience applying AI engineering practices in production or real\-world applications.
* Strong communication skills in English, with the ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders.
* Proficiency in one or more programming languages such as C\#, TypeScript, or Python.
  

  

Experience from one or more of the following areas is considered a strong advantage:


* AI Agents, Agentic Workflows, and Agent Frameworks such as LangGraph, Pydantic AI, Microsoft Agent Framework, or similar technologies.
* MCP (Model Context Protocol), including providing AI systems with context, tools, and access to enterprise capabilities.
* Large Language Models (LLMs), Small Language Models (SLMs), prompt and context engineering, evaluation, and model orchestration.
* Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector search, embeddings, and semantic search technologies.
* APIs, API Platforms, integration technologies, and secure access using open standards, as well as Data Products, Data Discovery, Analytics Platforms, and Developer Experience capabilities.

We look forward to your application!

jobs.title: .NET-utvecklare till riskbedömning
jobs.description:
**Att jobba som . NET utvecklare**


Vill du utveckla moderna försäkringslösningar och samtidigt få möjlighet att påverka både teknik och arbetssätt?


Hos oss blir du en del av ett erfaret team där samarbete, kunskapsdelning och dialog är en naturlig del av vardagen. Du får arbeta nära verksamheten och användarna, vilket ger dig snabb återkoppling på det du utvecklar och möjlighet att se hur dina lösningar används i praktiken.


Här får du dessutom vara med i en spännande teknisk förflyttning. Vi har lanserat den första versionen av vårt nya riskbedömningssystem och fortsätter nu utvecklingen samtidigt som äldre lösningar successivt ersätts.

**Därför kan det här vara jobbet för dig:**

* Du får kombinera nyutveckling och förvaltning och följa lösningar hela vägen från kod till produktion.
* Du arbetar med verksamhetskritiska lösningar som bland annat används för digital hälsodeklaration och medicinsk riskbedömning.
* Du får arbeta i ett erfaret team med nära samarbete och frekvent feedback från verksamheten.
* Du får möjlighet att bredda din kompetens mellan .NET och React, oavsett om din tyngdpunkt idag ligger inom backend eller frontend.
* Du har flera möjliga utvecklingsvägar framåt, exempelvis mot systemansvar, Scrum Master eller mjukvaruarkitektur.


Som .NET\-utvecklare arbetar du med utveckling och förvaltning av applikationerna i teamets portfölj. En viktig del är vår digitala hälsodeklaration och vårt riskbedömningssystem med regelmotor och handläggarstöd. Rollen innebär att du successivt bygger upp förståelse för helheten och tar ansvar för lösningarna även efter att de gått i produktion.

**Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter är att:**

* utveckla och vidareutveckla lösningar i .NET och React
* arbeta med felsökning, incidenthantering och förvaltning
* testa din egen kod och delta aktivt i code reviews
* hantera release och deploy samt arbeta med Azure DevOps och Octopus Deploy
* arbeta med SQL, integrationer och teamets olika applikationer
* samarbeta med bland annat riskbedömare, processägare och andra utvecklingsteam
* bidra med idéer, feedback och problemlösning tillsammans med dina kollegor.


Vi är 8 personer i teamet som består av bland annat utvecklare, testare, Product Owner, Scrum Master och mjukvaruarkitekt. Vi utgår från vårt huvudkontor på Kungsholmen i Stockholm och arbetar hybrid, med en kombination av arbete på kontoret och på distans. Du rapporterar till gruppchef IT inom IT Risk \& Hälsa.

**För att lyckas i rollen**


Vi söker dig med omkring fem års erfarenhet av systemutveckling och som relativt snabbt kan bidra i teamets leveranser. Du har erfarenhet av .NET\-utveckling och gärna React, men det viktiga är att du är nyfiken på helheten och vill utvecklas över gränserna mellan frontend och backend.


Du behöver kunna kommunicera väl på svenska i tal och skrift. Kunskaper inom SQL, Azure DevOps, CI/CD och releasehantering eller motsvarande är värdefulla eftersom du arbetar med hela utvecklingskedjan. Erfarenhet från försäkringsbranschen är meriterande.


Som person är du är noggrann, ansvarstagande och problemlösningsorienterad med förmåga att självständigt planera ditt arbete. Du söker orsaken när problem uppstår och tar dem vidare till en lösning, vilket är viktigt i arbetet med nyutveckling, förvaltning, felsökning och incidenthantering.


Samarbete och kommunikation är en naturlig del av rollen. Du delar kunskap, lyfter frågor och kan ge och ta emot feedback på ett konstruktivt sätt. Vi uppskattar också din nyfikenhet och vilja att sätta dig in i nya områden och förstå helheten.

**Vad händer nu?**


Vi jobbar med löpande urval så tveka inte att skicka in din ansökan redan idag. I ansökan kommer vi att ställa ett antal urvalsfrågor som ligger till grund för första urvalet.


Läs mer om hela vår rekryteringsprocess här.


Om du har frågor kring rollen, vänligen kontakta rekryterande chef Patric Wu på patric.wu@skandia.se. Om du har frågor kopplat till rekryteringsprocess, vänligen ta kontakt med Talent Acquisition Partner på madelene.skogh@skandia.se.


Vi kommer att återkoppla till alla som söker oavsett om du går vidare eller inte.


Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

**Mer om IT**


Vi på Skandia IT är stolta över att vara en kundorienterad enhet som levererar effektiva och säkra lösningar för våra kunder. Med cirka 600 engagerade medarbetare är vi mitt i en spännande transformationsresa, där vi utvecklas tillsammans och har kul på vägen. Framåt tillsammans är vårt motto!


Vi arbetar agilt och har sedan 2017 använt oss av SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework) ramverket, där leverans och kundvärde alltid står i centrum. Våra tågledningar och team, jobbar verksamhetsbaserat med aktiviteter som sprintplanering, daily stand\-ups, team\-synk, code reviews och retrospektiv.


Var 12:e vecka samlas vi alla i vår ljusa och inspirerande Ljusgård på kontoret i Stockholm för 2 planeringsdagar. Planeringsperioden består av 6 tvåveckorssprintar, där den sista sprinten är en innovationssprint. Här får du chansen att, själv eller tillsammans med ditt team, utveckla och förfina våra system.

jobs.title: AI-First Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Nion is an IT consultancy with offices in Stockholm, Malmö, Gothenburg, Skopje, Bitola and Sofia, where 200\+ IT specialists work together to deliver tailored digital solutions. Our clients operate in industries such as telecom, fintech and insurance, and we help organisations simplify complex challenges and create real business value.


We're looking for an experienced **AI\-First Senior Software Engineer** for our Stockholm office.


This is not a "coder" role. Our position is deliberate: the era ahead needs software *engineers*, not software *developers*. AI has hyper\-accelerated the software cycle — but it cannot hold accountability. The engineer does. With AI handling most code generation, human attention becomes the scarce resource and moves upstream and downstream of the keyboard: to priorities, trade\-off decisions, governance and final judgment, while agents handle execution in between.


Your job is to do what AI cannot — set direction, make the judgement calls, and keep acceleration from turning into compounding risk across functionality, security, compliance, maintainability and knowledge continuity. The Factory's goal is accelerated, secure and *sustainable* software delivery, and you are the person who holds that line.

**What you'll do**

* **System design.** Own the big picture — how components fit together, how data flows, how failures propagate. Modularity, standards and flexibility, not just the unit of code in front of you.
* **Domain modelling.** Understand the client's business problem deeply enough to design the *right* solution, not just a working one. Widening the problem context is where the real advantage is.
* **Architectural patterns.** Know which patterns to apply, when and why. As AI produces design artefacts faster than organisations can evaluate trade\-offs, your role shifts toward decision engineering — choosing and validating, not just producing.
* **Process design — the core responsibility.** Design the repeatable process by which software gets built, tested, deployed and maintained. In practice this means designing and orchestrating agentic coding flows, including patterns such as *orchestrator–worker* (an orchestrator decides sub\-tasks, initiates them and synthesises results) and *evaluator–optimizer* (one model generates, a second evaluates and feeds back, and the loop iterates). You decide where a deterministic workflow is right versus a more autonomous agent.
* **Quality judgment.** Know what good looks like, recognise when AI output is wrong, and have the discipline to reject it. Quality control moves from line\-by\-line review toward designing tests, feedback loops and validation checkpoints.
* **Tooling — the right tool for the job.** Fluency across product\-development tools, AI\-acceleration (code\-generation) tools, infrastructure tools and quality\-control tools. The best results come when tools have full access to the specific codebase and knowledge base — and well\-structured, standardised codebases yield the largest gains.
* **Accountability.** You hold accountability — not the AI. Put bluntly: vibe coding is not software engineering.

**Your profile**

* 8\+ years of hands\-on software engineering, with deep fundamentals in architecture, system design, modularity and standards (non\-negotiable — AI amplifies skill, it doesn't substitute for it)
* An early adopter of AI\-first development, with **proven, in\-production experience implementing AI\-first software development processes** — not just experimenting with tooling
* Demonstrable experience designing and orchestrating agentic / AI\-assisted development workflows (orchestrator–worker, evaluator–optimizer, and workflow\-vs\-agent decisions)
* Strong critical evaluation of AI output and the discipline to reject it
* Test design, feedback\-loop design and validation skills over line\-by\-line review
* Security, compliance and maintainability awareness in AI\-accelerated pipelines
* Infrastructure / CI\-CD fluency and the ability to work across the full SDLC
* Domain\-modelling ability — translating a business problem into the right technical solution
* Prompt and context engineering as a working skill, not a novelty
* Strong collaboration and communication, with deep client and product integration
* Fluent in Swedish and English, written and spoken

**Tools you'll work with**

* **AI\-acceleration:** Claude Code, agentic coding tools and LLM platforms (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI / Azure OpenAI)
* **Languages \& engineering:** .NET, Java or Python at senior depth, with strong Git and code\-review practice
* **Workflow orchestration:** agent frameworks and multi\-step orchestration (orchestrator–worker, evaluator–optimizer patterns)
* **Infrastructure:** CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes
* **Quality control:** automated testing, evaluation and validation frameworks for AI\-assisted output

**Meritorious**

* Anthropic Claude certification or equivalent AI platform credentials
* Experience standing up AI\-first processes at team or organisation scale
* LLM evaluation, guardrails and testing strategy experience
* Domain experience in telecom, fintech or insurance
* Prior consulting or client\-facing delivery experience

**What this role is not**


It is not a prompt\-driven "code typist," and it is not someone who ships unreviewed AI output. Used incorrectly, AI tools make a codebase *less* reliable, and automated processes compound that risk. Your judgement, ownership and process design are the product.

**We're looking for someone who is**

* Professional and committed to delivering solutions that meet real business needs
* Accountable and self\-driven — you take ownership of the big things and the small things
* Communicative and a team player; resilient under the cognitive load of carrying large context (we build teams with fail\-over and redundancy, because AI burn\-out is real)
* Flexible and open to some travel in connection with client projects

**With us you get**

* A collaborative, flat organisation where support is a given. Your consultant manager acts as a mentor to ensure your professional development and wellbeing.
* A clear career path and continuous learning through projects, mentorship and skills development.
* A vibrant company culture with strong team spirit, knowledge sharing and social activities that make work fun.

**Selected benefits**

* Opportunity for part\-ownership
* Competitive fixed salary
* 30 days holiday
* Company laptop, phone and subscription


Ready for the next step in your career? Send us your application.


Engineering judgement, accelerated — that's how we make IT easy.

jobs.title: CRM Solutions Developer
jobs.description:
Aurobay develops and produces world\-class hybrid engines and transmissions. With factories on two continents \- Sweden and China \- we're a pioneering global supplier of propulsion technology, development services and contract manufacturing. The Aurobay brand brings together over 9,000 dedicated and determined people that design, develop, and manufacture next\-generation powertrain solutions for a global market.


Aurobay is part of HORSE Powertrain Limited, a global leader in powertrain solutions. The Group has 19,000 employees, 17 plants and 5 R\&D centers across three continents. We partner with OEM customers around the world and offer innovative solutions that can cater to up to 80% of the growing hybrid and combustion powertrain market, enabling a faster transition toward cleaner mobility.


At Aurobay, we are committed to diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that different perspectives and experiences make for a stronger, more innovative company.


We are looking for a CRM Solutions Developer who combines hands\-on software development with strong experience in CRM platforms such as Hubspot or SalesForce, Power Platform, Azure, APIs, and system integrations. The role develops and maintains end\-to\-end CRM solutions that support sales processes, reliable customer data, and efficient integrations across the enterprise application landscape.


You will work closely with business stakeholders, product teams, and IT specialists to translate requirements into robust, scalable, and user\-friendly technical solutions. The position suits a communicative and structured developer who is comfortable taking responsibility from requirements and solution design through development, deployment, support, and continuous improvement.


﻿

**Key Responsibilities and Scope**

* Develop, configure, and maintain solutions in our CRM system and Power Platform.
* Build CRM functionality supporting lead management, prospecting, opportunities, activities, sales documentation, and follow\-up processes.
* Design and implement integrations between CRM, ERP, and other business systems using REST APIs, Azure services, and event\-driven patterns.
* Develop server\-side functionality, as well as client\-side functionality.
* Create and maintain Power Automate flows for automated and event\-triggered business processes.
* Contribute to customer data quality, harmonization, and golden\-record capabilities.
* Gather and refine technical requirements in dialogue with business stakeholders and convert them into maintainable solutions.
* Participate in solution design and architecture, applying clean architecture and domain\-driven design principles where appropriate.
* Use CI/CD, source control, and DevOps practices to support reliable development and deployment.
* Develop and integrate CPQ capabilities supporting product configuration, pricing, approvals, quote generation, and sales follow\-up.
* Design integrations between CRM, CPQ, PLM, ERP, and costing systems, including product structures, configuration rules, BOMs, pricing, and lifecycle changes.
* Monitor, troubleshoot, and continuously improve applications and integrations, including incident resolution and application support.
* Maintain technical documentation and contribute to secure, compliant, and well\-governed solutions.
* Collaborate within agile product teams and support knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.


﻿

* Strong knowledge of various CRM concepts, and common data structures such as accounts, contacts, leads, opportunities, and activities.

* Knowledge of CPQ concepts and CPQ\-to\-PLM integration, including product configuration, BOMs, pricing rules, master\-data ownership, synchronization, and traceability.
* Understanding of integration design, event\-driven solutions, authentication, data flows, and error handling.
* Familiarity with modern software engineering practices, including CI/CD, Git\-based workflows, clean architecture, and automated deployment.
* Understanding of agile development methods such as Scrum, Kanban, and DevOps.

**Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

* Experience building applications and integrations using Azure services.

**Skills**

* Hands\-on, curious, and solution\-oriented with a strong interest in learning and continuous development.
* Strucured and detail\-oriented, with focus on quality, maintainability, and business value.

jobs.title: .NET-utvecklare till riskbedömning
jobs.description:
**Att jobba som . NET utvecklare**


Vill du utveckla moderna försäkringslösningar och samtidigt få möjlighet att påverka både teknik och arbetssätt?


Hos oss blir du en del av ett erfaret team där samarbete, kunskapsdelning och dialog är en naturlig del av vardagen. Du får arbeta nära verksamheten och användarna, vilket ger dig snabb återkoppling på det du utvecklar och möjlighet att se hur dina lösningar används i praktiken.


Här får du dessutom vara med i en spännande teknisk förflyttning. Vi har lanserat den första versionen av vårt nya riskbedömningssystem och fortsätter nu utvecklingen samtidigt som äldre lösningar successivt ersätts.


**Därför kan det här vara jobbet för dig:**


* Du får kombinera nyutveckling och förvaltning och följa lösningar hela vägen från kod till produktion.
* Du arbetar med verksamhetskritiska lösningar som bland annat används för digital hälsodeklaration och medicinsk riskbedömning.
* Du får arbeta i ett erfaret team med nära samarbete och frekvent feedback från verksamheten.
* Du får möjlighet att bredda din kompetens mellan .NET och React, oavsett om din tyngdpunkt idag ligger inom backend eller frontend.
* Du har flera möjliga utvecklingsvägar framåt, exempelvis mot systemansvar, Scrum Master eller mjukvaruarkitektur.

Som .NET\-utvecklare arbetar du med utveckling och förvaltning av applikationerna i teamets portfölj. En viktig del är vår digitala hälsodeklaration och vårt riskbedömningssystem med regelmotor och handläggarstöd. Rollen innebär att du successivt bygger upp förståelse för helheten och tar ansvar för lösningarna även efter att de gått i produktion.


**Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter är att:**


* utveckla och vidareutveckla lösningar i .NET och React
* arbeta med felsökning, incidenthantering och förvaltning
* testa din egen kod och delta aktivt i code reviews
* hantera release och deploy samt arbeta med Azure DevOps och Octopus Deploy
* arbeta med SQL, integrationer och teamets olika applikationer
* samarbeta med bland annat riskbedömare, processägare och andra utvecklingsteam
* bidra med idéer, feedback och problemlösning tillsammans med dina kollegor.

Vi är 8 personer i teamet som består av bland annat utvecklare, testare, Product Owner, Scrum Master och mjukvaruarkitekt. Vi utgår från vårt huvudkontor på Kungsholmen i Stockholm och arbetar hybrid, med en kombination av arbete på kontoret och på distans. Du rapporterar till gruppchef IT inom IT Risk \& Hälsa.


**För att lyckas i rollen**


Vi söker dig med omkring fem års erfarenhet av systemutveckling och som relativt snabbt kan bidra i teamets leveranser. Du har erfarenhet av .NET\-utveckling och gärna React, men det viktiga är att du är nyfiken på helheten och vill utvecklas över gränserna mellan frontend och backend.


Du behöver kunna kommunicera väl på svenska i tal och skrift. Kunskaper inom SQL, Azure DevOps, CI/CD och releasehantering eller motsvarande är värdefulla eftersom du arbetar med hela utvecklingskedjan. Erfarenhet från försäkringsbranschen är meriterande.


Som person är du är noggrann, ansvarstagande och problemlösningsorienterad med förmåga att självständigt planera ditt arbete. Du söker orsaken när problem uppstår och tar dem vidare till en lösning, vilket är viktigt i arbetet med nyutveckling, förvaltning, felsökning och incidenthantering.


Samarbete och kommunikation är en naturlig del av rollen. Du delar kunskap, lyfter frågor och kan ge och ta emot feedback på ett konstruktivt sätt. Vi uppskattar också din nyfikenhet och vilja att sätta dig in i nya områden och förstå helheten.


**Vad händer nu?**


Vi jobbar med löpande urval så tveka inte att skicka in din ansökan redan idag. I ansökan kommer vi att ställa ett antal urvalsfrågor som ligger till grund för första urvalet.


Läs mer om hela vår rekryteringsprocess här.


Om du har frågor kring rollen, vänligen kontakta rekryterande chef Patric Wu på patric.wu@skandia.se. Om du har frågor kopplat till rekryteringsprocess, vänligen ta kontakt med Talent Acquisition Partner på madelene.skogh@skandia.se.


Vi kommer att återkoppla till alla som söker oavsett om du går vidare eller inte.


Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!


**Mer om IT**


Vi på Skandia IT är stolta över att vara en kundorienterad enhet som levererar effektiva och säkra lösningar för våra kunder. Med cirka 600 engagerade medarbetare är vi mitt i en spännande transformationsresa, där vi utvecklas tillsammans och har kul på vägen. Framåt tillsammans är vårt motto!


Vi arbetar agilt och har sedan 2017 använt oss av SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework) ramverket, där leverans och kundvärde alltid står i centrum. Våra tågledningar och team, jobbar verksamhetsbaserat med aktiviteter som sprintplanering, daily stand\-ups, team\-synk, code reviews och retrospektiv.


Var 12:e vecka samlas vi alla i vår ljusa och inspirerande Ljusgård på kontoret i Stockholm för 2 planeringsdagar. Planeringsperioden består av 6 tvåveckorssprintar, där den sista sprinten är en innovationssprint. Här får du chansen att, själv eller tillsammans med ditt team, utveckla och förfina våra system.

IT
Platser
Stockholm
Distansarbete
Hybridarbete

jobs.title: Power Platform Developer | SEB, Solna
jobs.description:
Low\-code is a way for a bank to move fast without cutting corners. Our team makes that possible. Join us in the Power Platform team, where we work with platform adoption, governance and support, to make sure good ideas don’t end up gathering dust on a shelf or take a year to reach production.



SEB is more than just a bank with an IT function. We are a progressive tech company powered by innovation and fuelled by collaboration. From COBOL to AI and everything in between, we offer you an impressive tech stack and several technology paths. Together we're innovating for a sustainable society and building the tech arena of the future, a welcoming space for everyone. Are you ready to take on a new challenge? If so, you'll be interested in this opportunity!  

  

**About the role:**  

As a Power Platform developer in our Center of Excellence, you join a team that owns the platform end to end. We handle administration and governance on the platform, and we work with business units across the bank to help them build apps, automations and AI agents that support our transformation journey.



This is a developer role, but expect to spend a lot of time alongside other teams rather than in your own backlog. You will help projects and initiatives to succeed by providing support, guidance and training. Some weeks that might mean co\-building, other weeks it could mean workshops, and sometimes it’s an honest conversation about why something shouldn’t be built the way it’s been drawn up.

  

**In this role you will:**



* Run enablement in practice: workshops, templates, reusable patterns, development standards, and the maker community around them
* Guide business teams through their Power Platform work, from first idea to a solution they can own and maintain themselves
* Help teams make solutions safe and compliant by default, covering environment strategy, DLP, access, agent grounding and data handling, and explain the reasoning behind it
* Contribute to how the CoE itself runs: tooling, monitoring and the platform standards we ask the bank to follow
* Follow where the platform is heading, and translate that into practical guidance for our makers
* Stay up to date with industry trends and emerging technologies to drive innovation in automation development
  


  

**To thrive in this role, we believe you have:**



* Hands\-on experience building and developing solutions with Microsoft Power Platform
* Experience with Copilot Studio or comparable agent tooling
* Some scripting or pro\-code background such as PowerShell, C\# or JavaScript, enough to extend the platform when low\-code runs out
* Automation experience (i.e., RPA, PowerShell, CI/CD or any cloud\-based automation tool, etc.)
* Familiarity with Azure Cloud services
* The ability to teach. You can take someone from confused to confident without taking over their keyboard
* Strong communication skills and comfort working with stakeholders at varying levels of technical fluency
* Excellent problem\-solving skills and attention to detail
* Fluency in English, written and spoken
  


  

**What we offer:**



* Agile and modern ways of working
* A flat hierarchy and openness to share ideas, opinions and points of views
* Extensive training and learning opportunities
* Work\-life balance
**Do you want to be part of SEB?**  

It is our fundamental belief that inclusion and diversity is crucial for our future success. We strive to have an inclusive, value\-driven culture where employees feel valued, respected, and involved irrespective of who they are, what they believe or where they come from.  

  

Since we select candidates continuously, feel free to send in your application today via the link in this ad, but no later than 2026\-10\-05\. If you have questions about the position, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner Mikaela Ahlstrand at mikaela.ahlstrand@seb.se. Kindly note that we do not accept applications via email.



Please be aware that our final candidates undergo background checks, a process that includes for example identity control, verification of qualifications, credit checks, company engagements and history of crime. In some cases, we also apply random drug checks.



During employment, employees within SEB can also expect to undergo recurring background checks.

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Job Description**

**Technical Architect, AI\-Powered Customer Experience**
--------------------------------------------------------

  

### **Why This Role? Why Now?**

  

Customer experience is being transformed by AI\-driven innovation. At Zendesk, we’re not just responding to that shift — we’re leading it. As we expand our AI\-powered Resolution Platform and deepen our Professional Services capabilities, the Technical Architect, AI\-Powered Customer Experience role is critical to helping customers design, implement, and scale intelligent customer service solutions that deliver measurable business value.  

  

  



As a technical expert, solution designer, and trusted advisor, you will help customers translate business goals into scalable AI\-first architectures. You’ll lead discovery, shape solution strategy, remove technical roadblocks, and guide customers toward successful adoption of Zendesk AI capabilities.  

  

  



### **Overarching Objective for the Role**

Accelerate customers’ time\-to\-value by designing and enabling AI\-first Zendesk solutions that drive adoption, automation, and measurable business impact from discovery through scale.


Be the customer’s AI technical architect. Turn business goals into the right architecture, integrations, workflows, and AI design choices.


Lead high\-quality solution discovery and delivery. Run technical discovery sessions, define solution scope, and guide customers through implementation with clarity and confidence.


Remove blockers fast. Anticipate risks, resolve constraints, and keep customer solutions moving toward successful outcomes.  

  

  

  



### **How You’ll Make an Impact**

  

Strategic Accountabilities


* AI Solution Architecture: Design scalable, supportable, and secure AI\-first architectures that enable automation, self\-service, agent assist, intelligent routing, and other Zendesk AI use cases.
* AI Adoption Enablement: Guide customers through rollout planning, change considerations, and operational readiness to support long\-term AI adoption while leveraging AI tools to enhance individual and team workflows for greater efficiency.
* Outcome Orientation: Ensure solution decisions are tied to measurable improvements in containment, deflection, productivity, resolution speed, customer satisfaction, and operational efficiency.
* Technical Discovery \& Use Case Definition: Lead customer\-facing discovery sessions to understand business challenges, technical constraints, and high\-value AI opportunities.
* Customer Advisory: Act as a trusted technical advisor, helping customers make informed decisions about architecture, integrations, data readiness, and implementation tradeoffs.
* Implementation Leadership: Partner with delivery teams to translate solution designs into successful implementations, ensuring technical quality, alignment to scope, and strong execution.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Support, Product, and Professional Services to align on customer strategy, risks, dependencies, and roadmap considerations.
* Integration \& Extensibility: Identify opportunities to extend Zendesk through APIs, app framework solutions, automation, and custom integrations where needed.
Problem Solving \& Innovation: Diagnose product gaps, technical constraints, or workflow limitations and recommend validated workarounds or design alternatives that preserve business outcomes.  
* 

  

  

### **What You’ll Need to Succeed**

Strategic Skills \& Expertise  



  

* Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to explain complex AI concepts clearly to both technical and executive audiences in English and German.
* AI\-First Thinking: Strong understanding of how AI capabilities can be applied across the customer service journey to improve efficiency, quality, and experience

* Solution Architecture: Proven ability to design end\-to\-end scalable, maintainable AI architectures
* Delivery Mindset: Comfortable balancing technical scope, customer expectations, dependencies, and timelines in a consulting environment.
* Problem Solving: Strong analytical thinking and practical judgment to evaluate tradeoffs and recommend solutions that work in the real world.
* Adaptability: Ability to thrive in dynamic, fast\-moving environments where priorities, requirements, and constraints may evolve.
Continuous Learning: Commitment to staying current on Zendesk capabilities, AI trends, customer service transformation, and modern integration patterns.  
* 

### **Qualifications**

Required  



  

* 5\+ years in architecture, machine learning engineering, solutions architecture, or technical consulting
* Experience designing and delivering AI/ML solutions in production
* Experience with AI\-powered service tools, automation platforms, or conversational AI solutions such as Decagon, Forethought, Ada, or similar
* Experience evaluating data readiness, governance, and operational readiness for AI solutions
* Experience in SaaS, enterprise software, or customer experience technology environments.
* Hands\-on experience with RESTful APIs, integrations, and solution design across web, backend, and/or mobile environments.
* Experience leading customer discovery sessions and translating business requirements into technical architecture.
* Ability to present technical solutions to both technical teams and executive stakeholders.
* Strong stakeholder management, consulting, and collaboration skills.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or equivalent professional experience.

Fluency in English and German, with the ability to communicate clearly with technical and executive audiences

Preferred

Experience identifying product gaps and proposing workarounds or extensions using app frameworks or custom development.
