jobs.title: Senior Software Development Engineer, Transactional Data Storage
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Do you want to work deep inside a database that processes billions of transactions every day across Amazon's consumer and digital businesses? Our team builds the data platforms at the core of Amazon, storing customer orders, catalog and product information, shopping carts, device data, and hundreds of other business\-critical datasets. The performance and availability of our platform is critical to the reliability of the Amazon brand, and we run some of the largest fleets and highest\-throughput services at the company.  

  

We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer who understands distributed systems at scale and wants to shape the shared storage layer of our next\-generation online transaction processing (OLTP) database. You will design how committed transactions are materialized to cloud object storage, how space is reclaimed as data is superseded, and how data nodes read back through a storage\-format\-agnostic contract. You will partner with Amazon Web Services (AWS) to leverage cloud\-native technologies and contribute innovations back to the broader market. If you thrive on solving ambiguous, high\-impact problems from design to delivery, we would love to hear from you.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Design, develop, and operate the distributed shared storage layer that holds the durable copy of every committed write for Amazon's mission\-critical OLTP database platform.
* Collaborate with Principal Engineers and peers to define technical solutions for complex problems such as storage engine design, durability and consistency protocols, read\-path caching, and backpressure under load.
* Own end\-to\-end delivery of features, from writing design documents and implementing production\-quality code to driving operational readiness and deployment.
* Mentor engineers through design and code reviews, pairing on hard problems, and helping them take on larger pieces of the system while raising the team's quality bar.
* Build monitoring, alarming, and automation that keep our high\-throughput services reliable, and participate in on\-call rotations to troubleshoot issues and drive root\-cause resolution.

  

A day in the life  

You will split your time between deep individual work like writing code, reviewing designs, and prototyping storage\-layer changes, and collaborative sessions with your team and partner teams. Expect regular design reviews where you debate trade\-offs around durability, latency, and cost, along with weekly operational reviews that keep the platform healthy. Some weeks you will be heads\-down implementing a new compaction strategy; other weeks you will pair with a teammate to debug a subtle consistency issue in production.  

  

About the team  

Our team sits within the Transact organization and is responsible for the storage engine layer that underpins Amazon's OLTP platform that powers all Amazon Stores. We are a group of engineers who care deeply about correctness, performance, and operational rigor. We partner closely with AWS service teams, sharing innovations in both directions. Our focus over the coming years is scaling the next\-generation storage layer to meet Amazon's growing transaction volume while improving efficiency and reducing costs, and we are looking for engineers who want to help shape that future.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree
* Experience in professional, non\-internship software development
* Experience in development in the last 3 years
* Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Java, C\+\+, or C\# including object\-oriented design
* Experience leading the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations
* Experience in debugging, profiling, and implementing software engineering best practices in large\-scale systems
* Knowledge of databases, storage and big data concepts
* Experience with performance and scalability testing

  

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy\_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.  

  

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.  

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Hos Blue Water Shipping er data og teknologi en central del af vores fremtidige udvikling. Vi er godt i gang med at bygge en moderne dataplatform i Microsoft Fabric, der skal understøtte en global forretning med stærke, skaler\-bare og værdiskabende løsninger. Efterspørgslen fra forretningen er stor, opbakningen fra øverste ledelse er tyde\-lig, og vores Data Platform \& Analytics\-team er vokset markant. Derfor søger vi nu endnu en Senior Data Engineer med stærk data engineering\-erfaring, som vil være med til at videreudvikle og udbrede vores dataplatform.


#### **Byg videre på en moderne dataplatform**


Du bliver en del af vores Data Platform \& Analytics\-team, hvor vi arbejder tæt sammen med forretningen om at ud\-vikle løsninger, der gør data mere tilgængelige, pålidelige og anvendelige på tværs af organisationen. Rollen har et tydeligt teknisk omdrejningspunkt, og du får mulighed for at påvirke arkitektur, datamodeller og måden, vi bygger, driver og udbreder vores dataplatform på.


Som Senior Data Engineer får du en central rolle i den fortsatte udvikling af vores dataplatform. Du vil både arbejde hands\-on med klassiske data engineering\-opgaver og være med til at sikre, at platformen kan understøtte nye te\-ams, applikationer og andre data consumers.


Dine vigtigste opgaver bliver blandt andet at:


* Designe tekniske løsninger, der er skalerbare, robuste og kan genbruges på tværs af organisationen
* Være med til at udvikle og udbrede platformens anvendelse til nye teams, applikationer og andre data con\-sumers
* Samarbejde tæt med forretningen og andre udviklingsteams om at omsætte behov til værdiskabende data\-løsninger
* Integrere nye datakilder på vores dataplatform
* Udvikle nye datamodeller

**Sæt dit præg med stærk backend\-erfaring og moderne data engineering**


Vi forestiller os, at du har solid erfaring med data engineering og moderne dataplatforme. Du har en stærk teknisk værktøjskasse og kan selvstændigt tage ansvar for en opgave fra problemstilling til færdig løsning.


Du har erfaring med at arbejde på en data platform, hvor data anvendes af flere forskellige consumers, og du for\-står, hvordan tekniske løsninger kan designes, så de skaber værdi ud over den enkelte leverance.


Derudover ser vi gerne, at du har erfaring med flere af følgende områder:


* Stærke kompetencer inden for SQL og Python
* Erfaring med datamodellering, transformation og integration af nye datakilder
* Erfaring med moderne data platforme og forståelse for platform architecture
* Erfaring med at udvikle løsninger, som anvendes af andre teams, applikationer eller analytikere
* Erfaring med teknologier som Microsoft Fabric, Databricks eller tilsvarende er en fordel

Som person er du nysgerrig, struktureret og løsningsorienteret. Du kan arbejde selvstændigt med tekniske pro\-blemstillinger, men motiveres også af at skabe løsninger sammen med andre. Du kan kommunikere komplekse tekniske problemstillinger på en måde, der skaber forståelse og fremdrift og du forstår, at vores vigtigste opgave er at skabe løsninger, der understøtter og skaber værdi for forretningen.


#### **Vi tilbyder**


Hos Blue Water Shipping tror vi på kontinuerlig forbedring og stræber efter at opbygge en kultur, der værdsætter innovation og forandring \- baseret på data som grundlag. Vores virksomhedskultur er præget af iværksætterånd, stort fokus på medarbejdernes trivsel og tillid.


Vi tilbyder en fleksibel arbejdsdag og opgaver, du selv kan sætte dit præg på. Du kan arbejde fra vores hovedkon\-tor i Esbjerg, Taulov eller Aarhus og kombinere det med 1\-2 dage om ugen i Esbjerg.


#### **Yderligere oplysninger**


Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, eller mangler yderligere oplysninger, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte Global Manager, Jesper Ravnborg Nissen på tlf. \+45 3124 9420\.


Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når den rette kandidat er fundet.


#### **Together we create solutions**


Vi er en stolt familieejet virksomhed, grundlagt i Danmark i 1972, og global leverandør af alle logistik tjenester in\-den for moderne supply chain management. Vores værdigrundlag lever i dag i bedste velgående og er drevet af en udpræget entreprenørånd og godt købmandskab. Vores medarbejdere tilbydes derfor et stærkt fagligt miljø med store frihedsgrader, som sikrer vores kunder den bedste service.


Blue Water Shipping er blandt Danmarks mest alsidige speditører og vores kunders lokale samarbejdspartner. Vi er repræsenteret med mere end \+2800 medarbejdere i 30 lande verden over, der kombinerer et stærkt globalt net\-værk med lokal ekspertise, som gør at vi kan tilbyde komplette og skræddersyede løsninger til ethvert forsendel\-sesbehov overalt i verden.


  
**Kontaktperson:**
Jesper Ravnborg Nissen Global Senior Manager Data Platform \& Analytics \+4531249420
**Lokation:** Aarhus, Esbjerg, Taulov
**Ansøgningsfrist:** 11\-10\-2026
**Type af ansættelse:** Fuldtid

We value autonomy and the ability to quickly pivot to capture opportunities, so we operate using our own capital and trading at our own risk.



Headquartered in Chicago with offices throughout the U.S., Canada, Europe, and Asia, we trade a variety of asset classes including Fixed Income, ETFs, Equities, FX, Commodities and Energy across all major global markets. We have also leveraged our expertise and technology to expand into three non\-traditional strategies: real estate, venture capital and cryptoassets.



We operate with respect, curiosity and open minds. The people who thrive here share our belief that it's not just what we do that matters–it's how we do it. **DRW** is a place of high expectations, integrity, innovation and a willingness to challenge consensus.



DRW is looking for an outstanding Senior Software Engineer to join our options trading desk. In this role, you will focus on designing, building, and implementing trading applications and tools. You will be an integral member of an algorithmic trading team comprising experienced technologists, quantitative researchers, and traders. Your team will work closely to solve challenging technological problems. We are looking for talented programmers eager to develop new technologies that directly impact our business.


**Responsibilities:**


* Design, build, test, and maintain data\-intensive desktop applications and reusable libraries using C\# and modern .NET
* Develop and maintain systems to ensure application performance, integrity and reliability for maintaining maximal up\-time, and logging and traceability to aid in the support of mission\-critical production systems
* Profile and improve rendering, memory usage, concurrency, reactive data pipelines, and application startup performance
* Collaborate with quantitative researchers, traders, and other developers
* Own software through its full lifecycle, including design, implementation, automated testing, instrumentation, deployment, staged rollout, and production support
* Leverage AI\-assisted and agentic development tools to accelerate delivery, improve software quality, and evolve the team's engineering practices.


**Requirements:**


* Bachelor's in Computer Science or related discipline or relevant work experience.
* 5\+ years of professional software development experience, with substantial experience building C\#/.NET desktop applications
* A thorough understanding of C\# UI development and tooling
* Should be comfortable in a fast\-paced environment that continually embraces the latest technologies and techniques.
* Effective communication skills, ability to read and write high and mid\-level architecture documentation
* Awareness of emerging technologies/standards

2027 Software Dev Engineer Intern - Iași, Romania
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Do you want to solve real customer problems through innovative technology? Do you enjoy working on scalable services in a collaborative team environment? Do you want to see your code directly impact millions of customers worldwide?
  

  

At Amazon, we hire the best minds in technology to innovate and build on behalf of our customers. Customer obsession is part of our company DNA, which has made us one of the world's most beloved brands.
  

  

Our Software Development Engineer (SDE) interns use modern technology to solve complex problems while seeing their work's impact first\-hand. The challenges SDE interns solve at Amazon are meaningful and influence millions of customers, sellers, and products globally. We seek individuals passionate about creating new products, features, and services while managing ambiguity in an environment where development cycles are measured in weeks, not years.
  

  

At Amazon, we believe in ownership at every level. As an SDE intern, you'll own the entire lifecycle of your code \- from design through deployment and ongoing operations. This ownership mindset, combined with our commitment to operational excellence, ensures we deliver the highest quality solutions for our customers.
  

  

We're looking for curious minds who think big and want to define tomorrow's technology. At Amazon, you'll grow into the high\-impact engineer you know you can be, supported by a culture of learning and mentorship. Every day brings exciting new challenges and opportunities for personal growth.
  

  

Amazon internships across all seasons are full\-time positions, and interns should expect to work in office, Monday\-Friday, up to 40 hours per week typically between 8am\-5pm. Specific team norms around working hours will be communicated by your manager. Interns should not have conflicts such as classes or other employment during the Amazon work\-day. Applicants should have a minimum of one quarter/semester/trimester remaining in their studies after their internship concludes.
  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Collaborate and communicate effectively with experienced cross\-disciplinary Amazonians to design, build, and operate innovative products and services that delight our customers, while participating in technical discussions to drive solutions forward.
  

  

Break down complex, ambiguous problems into well\-defined, solvable components before implementation.
  

  

Contribute to the design and development of scalable, reliable services, with distributed\-systems scope varying by team.
  

  

Participate in code reviews as a core engineering practice, providing constructive feedback and validating correctness.
  

  

Contribute to clear and accurate technical documentation.
  

  

Use GenAI and AI\-powered tools to enhance development productivity, and critically validate, verify, and integrate AI\-generated code, exercising sound judgement about when to trust AI output.
  

  

Write clean, maintainable code following best practices and design patterns.
  

  

Work in an agile environment practicing CI/CD principles while participating in operational responsibilities including on\-call duties.
  

  

Demonstrate operational excellence through monitoring, troubleshooting, and resolving production issues.
  

  

A day in the life  

As an intern, you will be matched to a manager and a mentor and will have the opportunity to influence the evolution of Amazon technology and lead critical projects early in your career.
  

  

In addition to working on an impactful project, you will have the opportunity to engage with Amazonians for both personal and professional development, expand your network, and participate in activities with other interns throughout your internship. No matter the location of your internship, we give you the tools to own your project and learn in a real\-world setting.
  

  

About the team  

Intern Community:
  

  

As an Amazon Intern, you'll be part of a vibrant, supportive community that empowers your growth and development. You'll collaborate with interns from around the world, networking and participating in social events to broaden your perspectives. You can also join specialized groups focused on areas like sustainability to explore your diverse interests.
  

  

Support:
  

  

The internship program provides a robust support system, including weekly intern office hours, dedicated IT and HR support, and a program team committed to your success. This ensures you have the guidance and assistance needed to thrive.
  

  

Learning Sessions:
  

  

Exclusive learning sessions will further enhance your skills, granting you access to Amazon's cutting\-edge learning platforms and the expertise of industry leaders. These structured development opportunities will prepare you for the next step in your career.
  

  

Opportunities:
  

  

Upon successful completion of the internship, you may be considered for a graduate role or a second internship, allowing you to continue your journey with Amazon. Additionally, you'll enjoy a competitive monthly salary, relocation support, and access to a range of employee benefits.


**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Are enrolled in a Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related fields at time of application
* Knowledge of computer science fundamentals such as object\-oriented design, operating systems, algorithms, data structures, and complexity analysis
* Experience with at least one general\-purpose programming language such as Java, Python, C\+\+, C\#, Go, Rust, or TypeScript

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience from a technical internship
* Experience with distributed, multi\-tiered systems, algorithms, and relational databases
* Experience with Cloud platforms (preferably AWS), database systems (SQL and NoSQL), AI tools for development productivity, contributing to open\-source projects, and/or version control systems
* Experience using AI\-assisted development tools in academic or professional settings
* Ability to effectively articulate technical challenges and solutions
* Adept at handling ambiguous or undefined problems as well as ability to think abstractly
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills

  

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy\_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.  

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

* You create materials based on instructions of the Lead Engineer.
* You structure files and organize computer\-assisted design.
* You take part in the dimensioning of simple installations/equipment based on standards, regulations, codes of practice and internal guidelines.
* You develop your knowledge within your field of expertise and in design tools.
* You take part in verifying implementation documents.

**We would love to hear from people with**


* Bachelor's/Master's Degree in Engineering;
* At least 3 years of experience in MEP Design;
* Involvement in engineering and design aspects and phases of projects: design, engineering, modelling;
* Expertise in using 2D \& 3D drawing tools (Autocad, Revit, Dialux);
* Good communication skills;
* Team player skills;
* Client\-oriented and flexible attitude;
* Strong analytical skills;
* Efficiency and general objectives;
* International driving license “B” is an avantage;

* You have a strong analytical and problem\-solving mindset.
* You communicate effectively and collaborate well in a team.
* You adapt easily to a dynamic work environment.
* You take a proactive and solution\-oriented approach to challenges.
* You pay attention to detail and are committed to delivering high\-quality work.

**Who we are**

**Our top priorities are people, ethics, safety, and sustainability.** With Tractebel, you are uniquely positioned to make a positive impact on global net\-zero targets. The driving force behind reaching these goals is our greatest asset: you. **Our people come first, and our strength is in our diversity.** Because diversity leads to fresh perspectives that drive performance and innovation, we welcome all applicants and remain committed to an inclusive workplace.


Find out more about Tractebel, our activities and why you should join us here !

jobs.title: Electrical Design Engineer (MEP)
jobs.description:
*Ready to engineer your positive impact? Then join Tractebel, part of the* ***ENGIE Group****, and our 5,000 passionate* ***experts*** *around the globe, driven by shaping a more* ***sustainable world*** *every day. It’s your chance to be a part of the adventure of the century: accelerating the energy transition – while enhancing people’s lives through meaningful projects. Make your contribution to* ***carbon neutrality*** *in markets like* ***nuclear, renewables, power \& gas, electrical grids, hydropower \& dams, water resources \& supply, desalination, complex \& high\-tech buildings, transport infrastructures, and ports \& waterways****.*



Are you ready to make a difference? Then we look forward to meeting you!


**What we offer**


* Tractebel is more than a place to work. It’s your chance to evolve alongside **top experts** on **impactful projects** around the world. It’s an environment built on **team spirit**, where you can reach your highest potential. Management actively supports the development of its people, and the opportunities for **growth** within the ENGIE Group are wide open.
* At Tractebel, we value our employees and believe in rewarding hard work. Our competitive salary reflects your experience and expertise, while our comprehensive benefits package is designed to support your well\-being and professional growth.
* We understand the importance of work\-life balance. That’s why we offer flexible hybrid work options, giving you the freedom to split your time between our modern offices and the comfort of your home. This approach is tailored to help you maintain productivity while enjoying a more balanced and fulfilling professional life.
* To celebrate our successes, and just have fun, we get together for sports, afterworks, team \-building activities, our parties, and more.

  


**Your mission**



As a MEP Design Engineer in our MEP team at Tractebel, you contribute to the development of large\-scale projects, delivering innovative and efficient engineering solutions. Our team focuses on designing and optimizing building infrastructure, ensuring reliability, sustainability, and technical excellence to support the transition to a cleaner and more resilient future.


**Your key responsibilities**


* You issue/collaborate to plans related to your field of expertise.
* You establish design principles for installations/equipment.
* You collaborate with the Owner and with other designers in developing the project design.
* You guarantee proper dimensioning of the installations/equipment.
* You control and monitor the creation and progress of any graphic materials and any measurement overviews.
* You issue Design Notes, Drafts, Models, Specifications, Technical Specifications and Briefs etc.
* You provide bills of quantities and cost estimates.
* You control and validate the produced documents (analysis, brief) before delivery.
* You comply with and enforce compliance with the Health/Safety guidelines set out in the Project Safety Plan.
* You create materials based on instructions of the Lead Engineer.
* You structure files and organize computer\-assisted design.
* You take part in the dimensioning of simple installations/equipment based on standards, regulations, codes of practice and internal guidelines.
* You develop your knowledge within your field of expertise and in design tools.
* You take part in verifying implementation documents.


**We would love to hear from people with**


* Bachelor's/Master's Degree in Engineering;
* At least 3 years of experience in MEP Design;
* Involvement in engineering and design aspects and phases of projects: design, engineering, modelling;
* Expertise in using 2D \& 3D drawing tools (Autocad, Revit, Dialux);
* Good communication skills;
* Team player skills;
* Client\-oriented and flexible attitude;
* Strong analytical skills;
* Efficiency and general objectives;
* International driving license “B” is an avantage;


**Who you are**

* You have a strong analytical and problem\-solving mindset.
* You communicate effectively and collaborate well in a team.
* You adapt easily to a dynamic work environment.
* You take a proactive and solution\-oriented approach to challenges.
* You pay attention to detail and are committed to delivering high\-quality work.


**Who we are**

**Our top priorities are people, ethics, safety, and sustainability.** With Tractebel, you are uniquely positioned to make a positive impact on global net\-zero targets. The driving force behind reaching these goals is our greatest asset: you. **Our people come first, and our strength is in our diversity.** Because diversity leads to fresh perspectives that drive performance and innovation, we welcome all applicants and remain committed to an inclusive workplace.



Find out more about Tractebel, our activities and why you should join us here!


***Please note \- roles and responsibilities may vary or can be tailored around your expertise.***


***At ENGIE, every talent has a role to play in accelerating the energy transition. Make a difference and enjoy a fulfilling professional experience. Take on exciting challenges and build a career path that reflects who you are. Join us and be part of the adventure of the century!***

jobs.title: Business Applications & Support Engineer
jobs.description:
**Neptune Lines Shipping and Managing Enterprises (Neptune Lines), part of Neptune Group**, is a leading finished vehicle logistics provider, specializing in transportation and shipping solutions for manufacturers and shippers of cars and high and heavy cargoes. Operating across Europe, North Africa, and the Black Sea, Neptune Lines excels in short\-sea shipping, connecting ports with efficient and specialized services. As a trusted partner for major car manufacturers, Neptune Lines delivers tailored solutions that meet the highest industry standards. Guided by its "Wake Forward" philosophy, Neptune Lines is committed to sustainability, reliability, and customer satisfaction, delivering operational excellence that drives progress in the logistics industry.

  

  

We are seeking a talented and tech\-savvy **Business Applications \& Support Engineer** to join our **Digital Transformation team**. You will play a key role in supporting, optimizing and continuously enhancing our core business systems and ERP applications. Acting as a vital link between technology, business operations, end\-users and external vendors, you will translate business needs into effective digital solutions, oversee system improvements and contribute to the successful delivery of transformation initiatives.

  

  

The position reports directly to the **Digital Transformation Manager**.

  

  

**Key Responsibilities**


* Analyze, support and enhance core business systems and enterprise applications, including ERP systems, ensuring alignment with operational workflows and business requirements.
* Design and develop tailored in\-house applications or custom scripts, as required, to address specific business needs.
* Act as the primary liaison between internal end\-users and external software vendors, facilitating effective communication and accelerating issue resolution.
* Oversee system installations, upgrades and configurations carried out by external vendors, ensuring timely, efficient and high\-quality project delivery.
* Design and execute comprehensive end\-to\-end testing and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to ensure system reliability and seamless performance.
* Deliver engaging training sessions and develop clear user documentation to support end\-users and promote the successful adoption of new technologies.
* Develop and deliver a wide range of reports, dashboards and data insights, supporting business continuity and providing Top Management with valuable information for decision\-making.
  

  

**Required Qualifications**


* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering or a closely related field.
* Experience: At least two years of relevant professional experience in application support, business analysis, ERP implementation or a related field.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Greek and English (a third language will be considered an asset).
  

  

**Skills**


* Strong hands\-on knowledge of relational database management systems, with particular emphasis on Microsoft SQL Server and T\-SQL.
* Familiarity with at least one major programming language, such as Python, C\#, Java, PHP or VB.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple responsibilities effectively in a fast\-paced environment.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in both Greek and English, including the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non\-technical audiences.
* A proactive and collaborative team player who can also work independently, quickly adapt to emerging technologies and demonstrate a strong commitment to continuous improvement.
* Experience with Business Intelligence tools, such as Power BI or QlikView, and the ability to transform raw data into meaningful and actionable dashboards will be considered an asset.
* Familiarity with Robotic Process Automation (RPA) and workflow automation tools, such as Power Automate or UiPath, will be considered an asset.
  

  

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and are committed to ensuring that our employment practices do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, marital status, medical condition, disability, or any other legally protected status. By applying, you agree to the Consent Form for the Processing of Personal Data(GDPR). More information can be found at: https://www.neptunelines.com/consent\-form\-processing\-personal\-data

jobs.description:
**Chaque moment compte. Surtout ceux que vous vivez à fond. Bienvenue chez Consort Group.**


Consort Group, accompagne depuis plus de 30 ans les entreprises dans la valorisation de leurs données et infrastructures. Elle s'appuie sur deux leaders, Consortis et Consortia, et place l’humain et la responsabilité sociétale au cœur de ses valeurs.


**C’est votre future équipe**


Mobilisée pour la réussite de ses clients, l’équipe de Consort Belgium incarne les valeurs et partage les expertises de Consort Group à Bruxelles, dans ses environs, et sur l’ensemble du territoire belge. Forte de 45 collaborateurs, elle propose depuis 2016 une offre de services en Infrastructures et Solutions Applicatives, portée par des équipes locales et appuyée, lorsque nécessaire, par les compétences et ressources du groupe.

  

  

**Développeur .Net Sénior** **H/F**


**C’est votre mission**


Vous êtes passionné·e par le **développement .NET et les architectures web modernes** ? Ce poste est fait pour vous.


En tant que **Développeur .NET / Blazor**, vous intégrez une équipe produit en charge de solutions **Portals \& Platforms**. Vous participez à la conception, au développement et à l’évolution d’applications critiques dans un environnement technologique exigeant, avec une forte utilisation de **.NET 8 et Blazor WebAssembly**.


Côté build :


* Concevoir et développer de nouvelles fonctionnalités en **.NET 8 / C\#** et **Blazor WebAssembly**
* Développer des composants et services applicatifs robustes et maintenables
* Implémenter la couche d’accès aux données avec **Entity Framework Core**
* Concevoir et exploiter des bases de données **SQL Server** et **MongoDB**
* Mettre en œuvre des échanges asynchrones et des architectures orientées événements avec **RabbitMQ**
* Participer à la conception et à l'évolution de solutions basées sur des **microservices**
* Écrire et maintenir les tests automatisés selon une approche **TDD**
* Veiller à la qualité, la performance et la maintenabilité du code produit

Côté run :


* Assurer la maintenance corrective et évolutive des applications existantes
* Analyser et résoudre les incidents et problèmes techniques rencontrés sur les applications
* Garantir la qualité et la stabilité des développements livrés
* Identifier les améliorations techniques permettant de renforcer la fiabilité et la maintenabilité des solutions
* Collaborer avec les équipes produit et techniques afin d'assurer la continuité et l'évolution des services

**C’est votre parcours**


Vous avez une expérience significative en **développement .NET**, idéalement dans des environnements applicatifs complexes. Vous aimez concevoir des solutions robustes, travailler sur des applications modernes et prendre en responsabilité vos développements de bout en bout.


Vous appréciez les environnements où la **qualité du code, les tests et la collaboration** occupent une place centrale.


**C’est votre expertise** **:**


* **.NET 8 / C\#**
* **Blazor WebAssembly**
* **Entity Framework Core**
* **SQL Server**
* **MongoDB**
* **RabbitMQ**
* **TDD et tests automatisés**
* Connaissance des **architectures microservices** appréciée
* La maîtrise du **français ou du néerlandais**, avec une compréhension passive de l'autre langue, est attendue. La maîtrise de **l'anglais** est également nécessaire.

Une expérience dans des environnements **Agile** et sur des applications à forte criticité constitue un atout.


**C’est votre manière de faire équipe** **:**


* Vous disposez de **bonnes capacités de communication** et savez collaborer avec différents interlocuteurs
* Vous êtes **autonome et responsable** dans la réalisation de vos missions
* Vous prenez en charge vos sujets de bout en bout et êtes capable de rendre compte de leur avancement
* Vous êtes attentif·ve à la **qualité et à la fiabilité** de vos développements
* Vous appréciez le travail en équipe et le partage de connaissances
* Vous êtes capable d'évoluer dans un environnement **international et multiculturel**

**C’est notre engagement**


Chez Consort Group, vous êtes un·e expert·e qu’on accompagne pour que chaque mission devienne une étape qui compte.


* Un onboarding attentif et humain
* Une vraie proximité managériale
* Des formations accessibles en continu
* Des engagements concrets : inclusion, égalité, solidarité
* Un package RH complet : mutuelle, carte TR, CSE, prévoyance
* Une culture du feedback et des projets qui font sens

**C’est clair**


Le process de recrutement :


* Un premier échange téléphonique avec notre team recrutement
* Un entretien RH ainsi qu’un échange métier avec un.e ingénieur.e d’affaires
* Un test ou un échange technique avec un.e de nos expert.es
* Un dernier point avec votre futur.e manager ou responsable de mission
* Et si on se reconnaît : on démarre ensemble
**C’est bon à savoir**


**Lieu :** Bruxelles
  

**Contrat :** CDI / Freelance
  

**Télétravail :** Hybride
  

**Famille métier :** Développement / .NET / Applications web
  

**Environnement technique :** .NET 8, C\#, Blazor WebAssembly, EF Core, SQL Server, MongoDB, RabbitMQ, TDD


**Ce que vous ferez ici, vous ne le ferez nulle part ailleurs.**
  

**Ce moment, c’est le vôtre.**

Consort Group, accompagne depuis plus de 30 ans les entreprises dans la valorisation de leurs données et infrastructures. Elle s'appuie sur deux leaders, Consortis et Consortia, et place l’humain et la responsabilité sociétale au cœur de ses valeurs.

**C’est votre future équipe**


Mobilisée pour la réussite de ses clients, l’équipe de Consort Belgium incarne les valeurs et partage les expertises de Consort Group à Bruxelles, dans ses environs, et sur l’ensemble du territoire belge. Forte de 45 collaborateurs, elle propose depuis 2016 une offre de services en Infrastructures et Solutions Applicatives, portée par des équipes locales et appuyée, lorsque nécessaire, par les compétences et ressources du groupe.

 **Développeur .Net Sénior** **H/F**

**C’est votre mission**


Vous êtes passionné·e par le **développement .NET et les architectures web modernes** ? Ce poste est fait pour vous.


En tant que **Développeur .NET / Blazor**, vous intégrez une équipe produit en charge de solutions **Portals \& Platforms**. Vous participez à la conception, au développement et à l’évolution d’applications critiques dans un environnement technologique exigeant, avec une forte utilisation de **.NET 8 et Blazor WebAssembly**.


Côté build :

* Concevoir et développer de nouvelles fonctionnalités en **.NET 8 / C\#** et **Blazor WebAssembly**
* Développer des composants et services applicatifs robustes et maintenables
* Implémenter la couche d’accès aux données avec **Entity Framework Core**
* Concevoir et exploiter des bases de données **SQL Server** et **MongoDB**
* Mettre en œuvre des échanges asynchrones et des architectures orientées événements avec **RabbitMQ**
* Participer à la conception et à l'évolution de solutions basées sur des **microservices**
* Écrire et maintenir les tests automatisés selon une approche **TDD**
* Veiller à la qualité, la performance et la maintenabilité du code produit


Côté run :

* Assurer la maintenance corrective et évolutive des applications existantes
* Analyser et résoudre les incidents et problèmes techniques rencontrés sur les applications
* Garantir la qualité et la stabilité des développements livrés
* Identifier les améliorations techniques permettant de renforcer la fiabilité et la maintenabilité des solutions
* Collaborer avec les équipes produit et techniques afin d'assurer la continuité et l'évolution des services

**C’est votre parcours**


Vous avez une expérience significative en **développement .NET**, idéalement dans des environnements applicatifs complexes. Vous aimez concevoir des solutions robustes, travailler sur des applications modernes et prendre en responsabilité vos développements de bout en bout.


Vous appréciez les environnements où la **qualité du code, les tests et la collaboration** occupent une place centrale.

**C’est votre expertise** **:**

* **.NET 8 / C\#**
* **Blazor WebAssembly**
* **Entity Framework Core**
* **SQL Server**
* **MongoDB**
* **RabbitMQ**
* **TDD et tests automatisés**
* Connaissance des **architectures microservices** appréciée
* La maîtrise du **français ou du néerlandais**, avec une compréhension passive de l'autre langue, est attendue. La maîtrise de **l'anglais** est également nécessaire.


Une expérience dans des environnements **Agile** et sur des applications à forte criticité constitue un atout.

**C’est votre manière de faire équipe** **:**

* Vous disposez de **bonnes capacités de communication** et savez collaborer avec différents interlocuteurs
* Vous êtes **autonome et responsable** dans la réalisation de vos missions
* Vous prenez en charge vos sujets de bout en bout et êtes capable de rendre compte de leur avancement
* Vous êtes attentif·ve à la **qualité et à la fiabilité** de vos développements
* Vous appréciez le travail en équipe et le partage de connaissances
* Vous êtes capable d'évoluer dans un environnement **international et multiculturel**

**C’est notre engagement**


Chez Consort Group, vous êtes un·e expert·e qu’on accompagne pour que chaque mission devienne une étape qui compte.

* Un onboarding attentif et humain
* Une vraie proximité managériale
* Des formations accessibles en continu
* Des engagements concrets : inclusion, égalité, solidarité
* Un package RH complet : mutuelle, carte TR, CSE, prévoyance
* Une culture du feedback et des projets qui font sens

**C’est clair**


Le process de recrutement :

* Un premier échange téléphonique avec notre team recrutement
* Un entretien RH ainsi qu’un échange métier avec un.e ingénieur.e d’affaires
* Un test ou un échange technique avec un.e de nos expert.es
* Un dernier point avec votre futur.e manager ou responsable de mission
* Et si on se reconnaît : on démarre ensemble

**C’est bon à savoir**

**Lieu :** Bruxelles  

**Contrat :** CDI / Freelance  

**Télétravail :** Hybride
  

**Famille métier :** Développement / .NET / Applications web  

**Environnement technique :** .NET 8, C\#, Blazor WebAssembly, EF Core, SQL Server, MongoDB, RabbitMQ, TDD

**Ce que vous ferez ici, vous ne le ferez nulle part ailleurs.**  

**Ce moment, c’est le vôtre.**

jobs.title: Customer Support Engineer
jobs.description:
**Summary**  

  

We are looking to hire a Customer Support Engineer as a part of Telesign Technical Support who will be working with our customers as well as with internal teams on troubleshooting issues, resolving them, or escalating problems. Technical Support Team is working in conjunction with other Telesign teams, employs a customer\-centric oriented approach to improve the quality of the service that Telesign provides.  

  

**Key responsibilities**  

  

* Identify, clarify, and resolve general and specific customer impacting problems.
* Provide professional, useful, and complete advice, training, and responses.
* Learn, apply, and articulate Telesign’s products, services, and operational technology to recommend potential uses and best practice for customers; to stay up to date with application changes.
* Drive increased customer satisfaction by exceeding expectations.
* Provide responsive support in line with company service levels and proper handling.
* Maintain accurate account information and settings in proprietary systems.
* Alerting and Communication – Internal and External.
* Provide additional monitoring after alert by responsible Telesign department.
* Evaluation and feedback on operational procedures/processes to ensure efficiency and security.
* Maintain and expand technical knowledge across Telesign products and services, tools, and processes.
* Contribute to and maintain technical documentation, responses, FAQs, knowledge bases and processes to help work efficiently across Support organization.
* Update relevant stakeholders with the most frequent customer questions or where customers experience confusion or issues.

 **Essential Requirements**  

  

* 2\-3 years’ experience in a mid or high\-level customer facing role.
* Fluent English, excellent verbal and written.
* Fast Learner.
* High level of responsibility.
* Team orientated.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and analytical skills; logical and critical thinking.
* Strong Customer care and focus.
* Positive attitude and results\-driven motivation.
* Ability to translate technical knowledge and concepts to non\-technical people.
* Strong ability to prioritize and multi\-task in a fast\-paced environment.
* Attention to detail.
* MS Office package \- relevant knowledge.
* Ability to work in shifts (24/7 shift schedule).

  

**Preferred Qualifications**  

  

* Working understanding of any of basic technical concepts of REST API, Java, PHP, Ruby, C\#, Python …
* Familiarity with Salesforce ticketing systems (” Service cloud”), Atlassian tools (JIRA, Status Page), ”Kibana”, ”Grafana”, “Confluence”\- will be treated as advantage.
* Telecom and Messaging experience (CPaaS, SMS, Voice, telecom data, Carrier ecosystem).

  

**We are offering*** Good compensation \- Competitive € salary plus benefits package.
* Development opportunities.
* Challenging but also a friendly working environment.
* And much, much more...

**About Proximus Global**  

  

Proximus Global, combining the strengths of Telesign, BICS, and Route Mobile, is transforming the future of communications and digital identity. Together, our solutions fuel innovation across the world’s largest companies and emerging brands. Our unrivalled global reach empowers businesses to create engaging experiences with built\-in fraud protection across the entire customer lifecycle.  

  

Our comprehensive suite of solutions – from our super network for voice, messaging, and data, to 5G and IoT; and from verification and intelligence to CPaaS for personalised omnichannel engagement – enables businesses and communities to thrive. Reaching over 5 billion subscribers, securing more than 180 billion transactions annually, and connecting 1,000\+ destinations, we honour our commitment to connect, protect and engage everyone, everywhere.

jobs.title: .NET Developer
Senior Software Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
#### **Die Rolle**


Du verfügst über tiefgehendes technisches Know\-How, denkst in nachhaltigen Softwarearchitekturen und möchtest die Weiterentwicklung moderner Anwendungen aktiv mitgestalten? Dann werde Teil unseres SCHUHFRIED Entwicklungsteams.  

  

In dieser Schlüsselrolle kombinierst Du Softwareentwicklung auf hohem fachlichem Niveau mit Unterstützung bei der Architekturverantwortung und begleitest das Team bei der Umsetzung zukunftsfähiger, skalierbarer Softwarelösungen.

#### **Die Aufgaben**

* Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung unserer Softwarelösungen auf Basis von .NET, Angular und Azure
* Kontinuierliche Modernisierung bestehender Anwendungen und Architekturen
* Analyse fachlicher und technischer Anforderungen, Entwicklung nachhaltiger Lösungsansätze
* Enge Zusammenarbeit im multidisziplinären SCRUM Team
* Fachliche Unterstützung von Entwickler\*innen bei technischen Fragestellungen
* Technische Verantwortung für Qualität, Wartbarkeit und Skalierbarkeit unserer Anwendungen
* Mitwirkung bei Architektur und Designreviews sowie technischen Standards und Best Practices
* Mitgestaltung der technologischen Roadmap und Evaluierung neuer Technologien

#### **Das Profil**

* Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Entwicklung komplexer Softwarelösungen mit C\#/.NET und TypeScript
* Erfahrung in Entwicklung und Betrieb von Azure Cloud Lösungen
* Kenntnisse in Datenbanksystemen (MS SQL Server, Azure SQL)
* Sicherer Umgang mit ASP.NET Core und Angular
* Erfahrung im Design von Softwarearchitekturen und verteilten Systemen
* Erfahrung mit C\+\+/Win32 von Vorteil
* Effektiver Einsatz von KI\-Tools wie Claude Code
* Hohes Qualitätsbewusstsein sowie analytische, strukturierte Arbeitsweise
* Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse und Deutschkenntnisse

#### **Unser Angebot**

* Ein öffentlich gut angebundenes Büro in Mödling (Badner Bahn \& ÖBB) und einen großen Parkplatz für Mitarbeitende
* Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten
* Sportangebote (myClubs) und zahlreiche Firmenevents
* Bis zu 2 Tage Homeoffice pro Woche
* Bis zu 5 Tage bezahlte Freistellung pro Jahr für soziales Engagement

#### **Warum wir?**


SCHUHFRIED ist ein international erfolgreicher Hidden Champion im Bereich der digitalen psychologischen Diagnostik. Seit über 79 Jahren entwickeln wir wissenschaftlich fundierte psychologische Tests, die weltweit in den Bereichen Eignungsdiagnostik, Klinische Neuropsychologie, Verkehrs\- und Sportpsychologie eingesetzt werden.  

  

In unserem Unternehmen werden Werte wie Verantwortung, Vertrauen und Zusammenhalt gelebt. Es erwarten dich kurze Entscheidungswege, abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeiten und ein freundliches und offenes Arbeitsumfeld. Gerne geben wir dir in einem persönlichen Gespräch einen genaueren Einblick in die Bereiche, in denen unsere Produkte zum Einsatz kommen.  

  

Uns ist auch wichtig, hervorzuheben, dass wir Diversität in unserem Unternehmen in Bezug auf unsere Mitarbeitenden schätzen. Alle sind herzlich willkommen \- unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Religion, Ethnizität und sexueller Orientierung.

#### **Gehalt**


Laut Kollektivvertrag liegt das Bruttomonatsgehalt für diese Vollzeitposition (38,5 Std.) bei € 4\.190,57, wobei die Bereitschaft zur Überzahlung in Anlehnung an deine Qualifikation und Erfahrung gegeben ist.

#### **Interessiert?**


Wenn du an dieser vielseitigen Position mit hohem Gestaltungsspielraum interessiert bist, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung!  

Hast du schon erste Fragen? Einige haben wir hier in den FAQs auf der Karriere\-Seite auf unserer Website schon beantwortet: https://www.schuhfried.com/de/karriere/

#### **Ansprechperson**


Petra Oswald\-Ulreich  

Head of People \& Organisation  

Tel.: \+43 2236 42315\-370  

personal@schuhfried.com

jobs.title: Junior Graphics Programmer
jobs.description:
With multiple awards to our name, Larian Studios has proven that we’re dedicated to delivering high\-quality role\-playing games As we move on to new projects, the studio that brought you Baldur’s Gate 3 \& Divinity: Original Sin 2 is looking for a Junior Graphics Programmer to join the team and help us in crafting the high calibre games our fans have come to expect.
### **Responsibilities**

* Maintain and extend our proprietary engine's VFX systems (particle simulation, materials, post\-process effects, rendering/lighting pipeline)
* Collaborate closely with the Art/VFX department to implement top\-quality visual effects and grow our library of VFX components
* Debug and optimize code to meet quality and performance targets
* Document code features as you build them
### **Requirements**

* Thorough knowledge of C\+\+
* Strong technical background (bachelor's degree or comparable experience)
* Clear communication skills, written and spoken, in English
* Enthusiasm for making and playing great games
* Proficiency with modern graphics APIs such as DirectX 12, Vulkan, or Metal
* Skilled in using CPU and GPU profiling tools to diagnose and resolve bottlenecks
* Solid grasp of particle system algorithms, including GPU\-based implementations
* Strong command of shading languages, with a track record of writing complex GPU algorithms
* Comfort working with multithreaded systems
* Strong software design, problem\-solving, and debugging skills
* Comfortable collaborating with others and taking ownership of your work
### **Nice To Haves**

* C\# experience
* Experience shipping a game or console title is a strong plus
### **What We Offer**

* An international team of over 550 employees spread across 7 studios around the world, each of which have their own unique qualities, and maintain a small\-studio feel
* An open, collaborative environment where ideas are welcome and encouraged
* A managerial team consisting of highly experienced game developers at the top of their fields
* Sharing hobbies and passions with like\-minded colleagues
* Inclusive environment with many activities organized by the studios or the employees
* Commitment to making the best game possible for the fans, including listening to community feedback

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Barcelona
jobs.description:
Software Engineer
  
**Description:** We are looking for a Software Engineer with innovative and entrepreneur mindset who wants to be part of a software product development team of multidisciplinary professionals in the framework of the industrial automation.
  
  

About Your Role
  
As a Software Engineer you will be responsible for extending and evolving the Omron Software Platform. You will join our Development team located in Barcelona with the mission to develop Drives Configuration and Programming software in the industrial automation field. You will work closely with other software engineers, test engineers, application engineers and you will be part of a global development team and take full responsibility for the product development.
  
  

**Duties and Responsibilities:**  

Transform requirements into software specifications
  
Translate software specifications into Features and User Stories
  
Design and implement the functionality for the requirements
  
Participate in code/design reviews and continuous improvement
  
Interact with stakeholders to improve the quality of the product
  
Provide influence on schedule, feature, and product designs
  
Identify bottlenecks and bugs, and devise solutions to mitigate and address these issues
  
Ensure the best possible performance, quality, and responsiveness of the software
  
Acquire and implement knowledge on new technology relevant for Omron
  
Achieve the best products in the market with passion
  
  

**Required Skills and Experience:**  

Bachelor s or Master s degree in Computer Science or a related field.
  
5\+ years of experience as a Software Engineer, with strong ownership across the full software development lifecycle (from design to post\-release), following best practices used in top\-tier tech companies.
  
**Strong expertise in the Microsoft ecosystem:** C\#, .NET, and desktop application development (WPF is a plus).
  
Solid understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including SOLID principles, clean architecture, and scalable system design.
  
Proven experience applying design patterns, writing maintainable code, and performing high\-quality code reviews and unit testing.
  
Experience working in modern engineering environments using practices such as CI/CD, DevOps, and collaborative development workflows.
  
Familiarity with cloud platforms (Azure or AWS) and distributed systems concepts.
  
Experience or exposure to modern front\-end technologies, especially React, and integration with backend services.
  
Comfortable working with modern development tools and approaches (e.g., AI\-assisted development / Copilots, vibe coding practices, rapid prototyping).
  
Strong problem\-solving skills, ownership mindset, and excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  
The knowledge and/or experience of any of the following would be desirable:
  
* Industrial Automation knowledge (PLC, Motion Control, Inverter, Servo, etc.)
* Experience in web/mobile development


We are not looking for perfect candidates, people who tick all our boxes. But we are looking for the right candidates individuals we feel can assure our customers success. We need people with character, positively minded who are confident of themselves and who can justify their confidence to us.
  
  

C\#, .NET, WPF, CI/CD, DevOps, Azure,

jobs.title: Senior Solutions Architect
jobs.description:
We are looking for passionate technologists to join our Pre\-Sales organization to ensure that our growth is grounded and guided by strong technical alignment with our platform and the needs of our customers.



MongoDB Pre\-Sales Solution Architects are responsible for guiding our customers and users to design and build reliable, scalable systems using our data platform. Our team is made up of seasoned technical sales professionals, software architects, entrepreneurs, and developers who take direct responsibility for customer success, including the design of their software, deployment, and operations. You'll work closely with our sales executives, helping customers solve business problems by leveraging our solutions, playing a key role in winning deals and driving the business forward. You'll be a trusted advisor to a wide range of users from startups to the world's largest enterprise IT organizations.



We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Madrid for our hybrid working model.


### **As an ideal candidate, you will have:**


* Ideally 8 to 11 years of related experience in a customer facing role, with 5 to 7 years of experience in pre\-sales with enterprise software
* Minimum of 3 years experience with modern scripting languages (e.g. Python, Node.js, SQL) and/or popular programming languages (e.g. C/C\+\+, Java, C\#) in a professional capacity
* Experience designing with scalable and highly available distributed systems in the cloud and on\-prem
* Demonstrated ability to work with customers to review complex architecture of existing applications, providing guidance on how to improve by leveraging technology
* Excellent presentation, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to convey complex technical and business concepts in a clear and compelling manner to technology and business leadership
* Ability to strategize with sales teams and provide recommendations on how to drive a multi\-threaded account strategy, aligning other MongoDB and ecosystem resources to move towards a mutually beneficial account plan
* The ability to travel up to 25%
* A Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience

### **You may also have:**


* Experience selling databases and/or deploying applications with any of the major cloud providers
* Experience with database programming and data models
* Experience in data engineering or AI/ML projects
* Experience in transforming legacy systems and platforms into modern, scalable, and efficient technology stacks
* Understanding of popular sales methodologies/ frameworks such as MEDDPICC/ Command of the Message
* A MongoDB Certification
* A Cloud Provider Certification

### **What you do at MongoDB:**



In this role, you will work on complex opportunities where analysis of situations or data requires an in\-depth evaluation of various factors. You will:


* Design and Architect: Design scalable and performant applications, systems and infrastructure for large software projects leveraging MongoDB
* Customer Advising and Value Articulation: Guide customers on architecture patterns and optimisation strategies for MongoDB, while clearly communicating its business value to the relevant stakeholders
* Sales Partnership: Collaborate with the sales team to drive account success through account planning, opportunity prioritization/qualification and pipeline generation strategy, while taking ownership of the technical aspects (including but not limited to technical discovery, demos, proof of value, presentations, sizing and documentation)
* Demand Generation: Proactively generate demand within the sales territory through self\-driven technical initiatives, participation in events such as industry trade shows and account\-based marketing events
* Customer Success: Foster strong customer relationships, build champions and ensure customer success and satisfaction
* Innovation and Improvement: Continuously seek opportunities to innovate and improve MongoDB solutions and processes (e.g. by relaying field feedback to the product team), as well as proactively mentor other Solutions Consulting team members
* Personal Training and Development: Engage in ongoing training and professional development to stay abreast of MongoDB product suite as well as industry trends

### **What you will learn:**



MongoDB Product Suite Mastery:


* Core Database Server: Master the fundamentals and advanced features of MongoDB's core database
* Atlas and Advanced Services: Gain expertise in Atlas (fully managed cloud database service), Atlas Stream Processing, Atlas Data Lake, Atlas Full\-Text Search, Atlas Vector Search, and Charts
* Relational Migrator: Learn to migrate from relational databases seamlessly


Market\-Relevant Technologies:


* Hyperscaler Ecosystem: Gain expertise in designing complex systems utilizing cloud services on hyperscaler platforms
* Complementary Technologies: Enhance your skills with partner and complementary technologies such as Apache Kafka and Kubernetes


Modern Architecture Design:


* Design Patterns and Methodologies: Embrace best practices in microservices, DevOps, cloud, and security
* Cutting Edge RAG and AI Architectures: Help customers on their generative AI journeys and working with industry leading partners in the space


Sales Techniques and Soft Skills:


* Effective Communication: Master presentations, demonstrations, and whiteboarding
* Client Interaction: Develop strategies for discovery and objection handling


Industry Insights:


* Diverse Market Verticals: Gain exposure to a broad spectrum of interesting use cases across various industries

### **About MongoDB**



MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB's unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud\-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi\-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.



With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI\-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we're powering the next era of software.



Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It's what makes us MongoDB.



To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we're committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees' wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it's like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!



MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.



MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

jobs.description:
**Clinical Data Engineer CDP \& DP**

  


  

  

**Main Purpose**

  



Drives the setup and maintenance of clinical data collection instrument(s), data ingestion and integration capabilities from all study data sources (sites and vendors – labs, IRT, ePRO, digital devices, etc.), based on the Clinical Study Protocol and Medical Standards in collaboration with the study team and other internal as well as external stakeholders.



Implements programs/listings for data quality checks as well as builds optimized data flow pipelines to enable risk monitoring processes (CDM, Med Review, Site Management, Med Coding) and statistical analysis/reporting.

  


**Key Tasks \& Responsibilities**

  


* Requirements \& Specification: Analyze clinical protocol to create requirements and technical specifications for data collection, data ingestion, quality measures, data integration and transformation for all study sources ensuring complete end\-to\-end focus.
* Task Delivery: Setup study level data collection elements as well as program triggers, derivations and data cleaning checks/listings/reports. Setup and perform data ingestion activities for CRO and vendor data, data exchanges with internal and external partner systems, as per agreed data transfer specifications. Develop and validate programs for study setup, conduct and closeout activities within the Clinical Data Environment/Lakehouse. Provide clinical study data to business users, ensuring smooth data flow and traceability while addressing any data flow issues.
* Project Management: Plan, prioritize, and communicate timelines for clinical studies. Support these studies throughout their lifecycle by evaluating issues, assessing the impact of changes, and implementing and testing updates. Ensure all study setup documentation is completed on time and comply with relevant SOPs to be ready for inspections and audits.
* Best Practices: Contribute as a subject matter expert for function level processes, systems/tools.

  




**Scope**

  


* Global

  




**Key Work Relations (Internal/External)**

  


* Clinical Study Team Members: Study Managers, Study Data Managers, Medical Experts, Statisticians, Statistical Programmers, Medical Writing, Drug Safety, Medical Coding)
* Technology Related Partners: IT System Owners, DSA\&I Process Managers/Clinical Data Engineers/Project Managers/Scrum Masters
* Enabling Functions: Standards Management, Vendor Management, Procurement, Customer Centricity, etc.
* External vendors and partner companies

  




**Skills \& Qualifications**

  

* Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Natural Sciences, Life Sciences, Statistics, Computer Science, Data Science or related fields. Equivalent degrees or certifications may be accepted.
* Experience: At least 3 years in a scientific, data\-driven position, preferably with experience working in the clinical data management discipline.
* Technology \& Programming: In\-depth experience in programming languages (e.g., C\#, SQL, SAS, Python, R) and clinical information systems following software development processes.
* Familiarity with big data technologies, cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP), and data integration tools (e.g., Databricks).
* Industry Practices \- Preferred: Understanding of global regulatory requirements and guidelines (e.g., ICH, GCP, HIPAA) related to clinical investigations and data collection. Knowledge of CDISC clinical data standards.
* Self Organization: Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to work independently and collaboratively in a global environment.
* Communication \& Collaboration: Strong communication skills in English, both written and verbal. Proven ability to collaborate with internal and external stakeholders demonstrating decision making capabilities.

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Us**  

  

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time\-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.  

  

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1\.7 trillion problem.  

  

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.  

  

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7\-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.  

  

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.


The Platform function at Perk builds the foundations that the rest of the company depends on. We own the shared infrastructure, core services, and developer tooling that enable product teams to move fast without breaking things. Our work is often behind the scenes, but its impact is everywhere: reliability, scalability, security, and developer experience.


We solve hard, systemic problems, make deliberate trade\-offs, and hold ourselves accountable for the long\-term health of the platform. If you care about leverage, clean abstractions, and building things other engineers actually enjoy using, you’ll feel at home here.


We are seeking a **DevOps Engineer** to join our team and help build, maintain, and scale the infrastructure and tools that empower our developers to deliver reliable, secure, and high\-performing services. If you’re an experienced Platform Engineer, or a Software Engineer with a passion for Platform and Developer Experience, we would love to speak with you.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* Design, build and maintain scalable, and reliable cloud infrastructure in AWS
* Enable development teams to be owners of their systems and to deliver high impact products to our users
* Partner with SRE and security teams to help developers build resilient and secure applications
* Participate in our on\-call and incident management process as part of a “you build it, you run it” mentality

**Requirements:**
-----------------

* Hands\-on experience managing systems in AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, VPC, etc.)
* Strong knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Pulumi, etc.)
* Solid understanding of CI/CD practices and tools (GitHub Actions, CircleCI, etc.)
* Experience with monitoring and observability tools (Datadog, CloudWatch, etc.)
* Experience with containerisation and container orchestration (Docker, ECS, etc.)
* Proficiency in at least one programming/scripting language (Python, Go, etc.)
* Strong problem\-solving and troubleshooting skills in distributed systems
* Excellent communication and collaboration abilities

### **Advantageous but not essential:**

* Comfortable working across a mostly Linux estate, with some exposure to Windows systems and .NET applications
* Experience with serverless architectures
* Experience with defining advanced cloud networking setups
* Familiarity with SOC2, ISO 27001, or other compliance frameworks

**AI at Perk**  

AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day\-to\-day are AI\-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work \- the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do \- so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

**How We Work**


At Perk, we take an IRL\-first approach to work, where our team works together in\-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.


For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.


Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

**Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams**


All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security \[at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

jobs.title: SAP Solution Engineer
jobs.description:
**World leader in allergy**


ALK is a global specialty pharmaceutical company based in Denmark, dedicated to allergy treatment and innovation for over a century. Present in 46 markets with production sites in the USA, Spain, France, and Denmark, we reach 3\.1 million patients annually and aim to help 5 million people living with allergies by 2030\.


Our 2,800 employees support this mission, with Global IT enabling modern technologies and world\-class support across the organization. The SAP solution is embarking on an S4HANA migration, and we are seeking an SAP Basis Consultant to strengthen our team.


**What will be your role?**


You will join to company's SAP global support team, a global department of about 30 people located at different sites in Europe, most of them located in Madrid, working in close collaboration with other SAP specialist in Global IT \- SAP Team.


**Your main functions will be:**

* Working in collaboration with colleagues within Global IT and end users around the world, you will take part in designing, installing, implementing, configuring, replacing, and documenting our SAP system platforms from an SAP Basis perspective.
* You will support, troubleshoot, and develop existing and future SAP systems and services and related, to ensure the highest level of performance and stability. It will include daily management, security management, kernel updates, system updates, homogeneous copies, EWA reviews, DRTs, troubleshooting.
* You will be also involved in the projects for developing our SAP landscape in the future either through implementing new systems or upgrading and enhancing the existing ones.
* Adhering to compliance and writing documentation based on Pharma regulations (GxP). Experience and demonstrated ability to achieve a kind of compliance is a must.
* Assisting in maintenance and release cycle tasks and working with team members to complete tasks needed for various projects.
* Travel around 10%.
* Occasional work on weekends, 1\-2 weekends per month, SAP system and OS Security patching, SAP Release support, Datacenter and Operations support.
* Availability during the emergency situations, semi \- on call availability.


**What We're Seeking:**

* An education in computer science, engineering or similar.
* Structured, able to work autonomously and to plan, structure and execute your own tasks or projects including coordination with colleagues and stakeholders.
* With good documentation skills and attention to details and accuracy.
* Proactive, service\-minded and team player attitude.
* Experience working with Agile methodologies.
* Experience in working on regulated environments with strong compliance requirements.
* Experience in working in multinational companies and multicultural environments.
* Team Player and good in sharing knowledge with colleagues.
* Wiliness to learn and a desire to grow in your professional career.
* Good communications skills and ability to work with diverse stakeholders in a global environment.
* Fluent in spoken and written English is a requirement – additional languages are an advantage.
* Experience with GxP and qualification of computerized systems is an advantage.
* Be ready to work on\-call and weekend work (maintenance and patching) around one or two weekends per month (paid).

 **Your knowledge of SAP must include:**

* You have been working the last 5\-10 years in the SAP Basis area and you’re used to work with cross function cooperation, quality mindset, timely delivery and compliance requirements being in high focus, and you are now ready for new challenges.
* Record of development and maintenance activities on system documentation for all SAP instances and interfaces following GxP standards.
* Experience in the administration of different SAP products: SAP ECC, SAP PI/PO, SAP ATTP, SAP BW, SAP BO, Solution Manager, Content Servers, S/4HANA, Hana Cockpit…
* Experience in SAP Cloud Services and applications (BTP/BDC//BAIP) like SII, DRC, BAS, Datasphere, Integration Suite, SAP Cloud ALM, SAP ICH, SAP Concur …
* Base knowledge of Security and SAP Security, Securing Hardening, System Parameters tuning.
* Base knowledge of Certificates, SAP Certificate Management Cloud and On\-Prem, network connectivity and integrations.
* Good English command and communication skills is a must.


 Valuable:

* Experience in DB management such as: HANA / MS\-SQL\-Server / DB2(DB4\)/MariaDB.
* Experience in OS administration, such as: Linux (SLES,SLE MICRO, SUSE Rancher, Kubernetes), IBM I OS 400, Windows .
* Experience in DR architectures and/or Business Continuity Plans
* Experience in archiving , including configuration of the archiving objects, planning, and execution of the archiving jobs.
* Experience with CHARM and System monitoring in SAP Solution Manager and in SAP Cloud ALM
* Experience in S/4HANA migrations.
* Experience with AI, mainly Joule Agent
* ITIL and ServiceNow experience.


**What can we offer you?**

* Stable contract
* To join a Company that’s consolidated and shows a great international growth, in which the most important element are the people that belong to it
* Interesting incentives and social benefits

**Why ALK Global IT?**


ALK’s IT division is a robust team of approximately 140 professionals with IT hubs in Hørsholm, Madrid, Krakow, and with employees throughout our production and sales networks in Germany, France, and North America and China. We prioritize professional growth and learning, valuing competency and knowledge exchange over formalities and encouraging a collaborative spirit every day.


You will have the opportunity to contribute to and make an impact on:

* Our SAP S/4HANA journey
* SAP CONCUR
* SAP Integrations solution
* Advancing AI, Analytics and digitalisation throughout ALK
* The Implementation of the global serialization solutions
* And many more innovative ventures!


**Become a part of ALK**


ALK provides a dynamic and accommodating work environment, complete with inspiring and challenging assignments. You are able to actively influence and challenge the status quo. Our flat structures attract independent individuals who like to feel the progress of the business and enjoy being close to the decision\-making process. We consider our pioneering spirit, coupled with our trustworthiness, our winning formula.


We operate production sites in Denmark, France, Spain, and the United States, with a global team of approximately 2,900 employees. Our headquarters is located in the scenic DTU Science Park in Hørsholm, Denmark.
